title: Dhikr and Remembering God
text: Those who remember Allah while standing, sitting and lying on their sides and meditate on the creation of the heavens and the earth and they cry out: Our God! You have not created this in vain.
arabic: ٱلَّذِینَ یَذۡكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِیَـٰمࣰا وَقُعُودࣰا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمۡ وَیَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِی خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَـٰذَا بَـٰطِلࣰا سُبۡحَـٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
kataKunci: Remember. God. Meditate. Creation. Symbol. Godliness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Worship is everywhere. Two:There are two type of supplications- To utter God's name and to meditate about God's creations. Three: Seek for beneficial furqan in life. Four: Sources of creations prevent hardships - To prosper with Godliness.
translit: alladziina yadzkuruuna llaha qiyaaman waqu'uudan wa'alaa junuubihim wayatafakkaruuna fii khalqi ssamaawaati wal'ardhi rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadzaa baatilan subhaanaka faqinaa 'adzaaba nnaari

title: Desiring the Life of This World
text: Those who desire the life of this world and its splendors, they are given full reward of their deeds therein and shall not be diminished.
arabic: مَن كَانَ یُرِیدُ ٱلۡحَیَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡیَا وَزِینَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَیۡهِمۡ أَعۡمَـٰلَهُمۡ فِیهَا وَهُمۡ فِیهَا لَا یُبۡخَسُونَ
kataKunci: Desires. Life. Blessings. God. World. Venue. Investment
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Matters revolving around desires and what sparks them. Two: Desire for life in this world. Three: Desires to develop life along with the world's splendors. Four: Desires for the world will not be wasteful. Five: Desires for the world as a venue for investment - Makes the world be useful.
translit: man kaana yuriidu lhayawaata ddunyaa waziinatahaa nuwaffi 'ilayhim 'a'maalahum fiihaa wahum fiihaa laa yubkhasuuna

title: Allah Raises a Person's Ranks
text: Allah will raise to higher ranks those of you who have faith and knowledge.
arabic: یَرۡفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِینَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ دَرَجَـٰتࣲۚ
kataKunci: Faith. Knowledge. Source. Ranks
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Issues pertaining to raising life's standards. Two: Raising life's standards. Three: Raising ranks through faith. Four: Raising ranks with knowledge - This leads to life's ranks.
translit: yarfa'i llahu lladziina 'aamanuu minkum walladziina 'uutuu l'ilma darajaatin

title: For Every Learned One, There Is One More Learned
text: We exalt in ranks whom We please, He is the One whose knowledge is far greater than the knowledge of all others.
arabic: نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتࣲ مَّن نَّشَاۤءُۗ وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِی عِلۡمٍ عَلِیمࣱ
kataKunci: The most pious. Far. Greater. Higher
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Matters related to increasing knowledge. Two: Increase of knowledge increases ranks. Three: Benefits of being knowledgeable is not restricts to a person alone. Four: Expertise in knowledge varies – This makes a person realize – advantages are not for one person - Knowledge does not come in a single field.
translit: narfa'u darajaatin mman nnasyaa'u wafawqa kulli dzii 'ilmin 'aliimun

title: Allah Is the Best Protector
text: Allah is the best protector and He is the Most Merciful of the mercy givers.
arabic: فَٱللَّهُ خَیۡرٌ حَـٰفِظࣰاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّ ٰحِمِینَ
kataKunci: God. Must. Tested. Only then. Servants. Smart
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the best guardian is God. Two: God bestows sustenance. Three: God bestows blessings. Four: God's authenticity must be tested – Only then will God's presence be felt.
translit: fallahu khayrun haafizan wahuwa 'arhamu rraahimiina

title: God of the Heavens and the Earth
text: Surely your God is one, God of the heavens and of the earth and all that lies between them, and the God of the easts.
arabic: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمۡ لَوَ ٰحِدࣱ رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَـٰرِقِ
kataKunci: God. Standing. Before. Eyes. Humanity
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Believe in the Almighty God. Two: God of the Heavens and the earth. Three: God owns two (2) levels of exaltation – Exalt in this world as well as in the hereafter.
translit: 'inna 'ilaahakum lawaahidun rrabbu ssamaawaati wal'ardhi wamaa baynahumaa warabbu lmasyaariqi

title: Prosperity at Three Times
text: Peace be on him the day he was born, the day of his death and the day he will be raised to life again
arabic: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَیۡهِ یَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَیَوۡمَ یَمُوتُ وَیَوۡمَ یُبۡعَثُ حَیࣰّا
kataKunci: Prosperity. Purpose. Life
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand - Life must seek to be prosperous. Two: Seek for prosperity while living in this world (at birth). Three: Seek for prosperity when returning to God (in death). Four: Seek for prosperity during resurrection (in the Eternity) – As blessings and favours
translit: wasalaamun 'alayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamuutu wayawma yub'atsu hayyan

title: Allah's Help Is for Happiness and a Calm Heart
text: Allah has told you this as good news and that your hearts my be at ease thereby; victory comes only from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ لَكُمۡ وَلِتَطۡمَىِٕنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِیزِ ٱلۡحَكِیمِ
kataKunci: Help. Happiness. Tranquility
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The concept of helping. Two: Helping refers to happiness. Three: Helping leads to tranquility. Four: If both are diminished, help will no longer be portrayed.
translit: wamaa ja'alahu llahu 'illaa busyraa lakum walitatma'inna quluubukum bihii wamaa nnasru 'illaa min 'indi llahi l'aziizi lhakiimi

title: The Path of Sustenance
text: Is it that you are asking them for some recompense? But the recompense of your God is the best, for He is the best provider of sustenance.
arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجࣰا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَیۡرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَیۡرُ ٱلرَّ ٰزِقِینَ
kataKunci: Sustenance. Cultivated. According to. Its path.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Ranks are exalted with the increase in knowledge. Two: Knowledge's advantages are not felt by a single person. Three: Knowledge's expertise comes in many fields – This makes a person realize – he is not the only one - Knowledge does not come in a single field.
translit: 'am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru rraaziqiina

title: Enter Well, Exit Well
text: Say: O' God, make my entrance with truth and make my exit, the exit with truth and grant me a supporting authority from your presence.
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِی مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقࣲ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِی مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقࣲ وَٱجۡعَل لِّی مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَـٰنࣰا نَّصِیرࣰا
kataKunci: Entrance. Well accepted. Exit. Accompanied with. Success
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Matters that ease tasks. Two: Easiness when starting a task. Three: Easiness when ending a task. Four: Easiness in obtaining help from the authorities - this helps a task successful.
translit: waqu rrabbi 'adkhilnii mudkhala sidqin wa'akhrijnii mukhraja sidqin waj'a llii min lladunka sultaanan nnasiiran

title: Coarse Inspiration and Taqwa
text: And inspired (Allah) it with knowledge of what is wrong for it and what is right for it; indeed successful will be the one who keeps it pure, and indeed failure will be the one who corrupts it.
arabic: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
kataKunci: Inspirations. Life. World. Inspirations. Life. Hereafter. Purity. Heart
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember about the importance of inspirations. Two: There are two (2) types of knowledge. Three: The rough inspiration is for the world's matters. Four: Righteous inspirations is for a Godly life - Proven useful.
translit: fa'alhamahaa fujuurahaa wataqwaahaa qad 'aflaha man zakkaahaa waqad khaaba man dassaahaa

title: Negative Water (Healing Water)
text: (Allah's decree to Prophet Ayub) Strike your foot on the ground. A cool spring (negative water) will gush forth. Wash and drink to refresh yourself (cure for illnesses).
arabic: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَـٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ
kataKunci: Breaking. Results. Compound. Elaborated. Source. Furqan. Natural. Product
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are six (6) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Issues regarding electrons in an atom. Two: When an electron is tossed out from its orbit. Three: The atom's structure will get altered. Four: Changes that occur causes alterations to its function. Five: Water turns into negative - A cure. Six: Machine to alter the structure – The N.M.R Machine – This refers to the Natural Science product.- Bio Chemistry.
translit: arkudh birijlika haadzaa mughtasalu baaridun wasyaraabun

title: Allah Alternates Night and Day (The Civet's Eyes)
text: Allah alternates the night and the day; there is indeed a lesson in it for those who possess insight.
arabic: یُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّیۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِی ذَ ٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةࣰ لِّأُو۟لِی ٱلۡأَبۡصَـٰرِ
kataKunci: Concept. Light. Darkness. Alternates
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are seven (7) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Matters related to the earth's rotation. Two: The sun stands tall without rotating. Three: Night and day are alternated. Four: The trait of man thinking similar to a flight of stairs. Five: Man of the Ulul Albab status. Six: Man with an insight. Seven: Sensitive with the surrounding's happenings – Observing the surrounding with aqliah.
translit: yuqallibu llahu llayla wannahaara 'inna fii dzaalika la'ibratan lli'ulii l'absaari

title: The Best Chosen People
text: And mention Our devotees: Ibrahim, Ishak and Ya'aqub men of power (desires and determination) and vision (based on a high levels of knowledgeability). Surely We chose them for their special quality of keeping in mind the abode hereafter. Certainly they are with Us; among the best chosen.
arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَـٰدَنَاۤ إِبۡرَ ٰهِیمَ وَإِسۡحَـٰقَ وَیَعۡقُوبَ أُو۟لِی ٱلۡأَیۡدِی وَٱلۡأَبۡصَـٰرِ إِنَّاۤ أَخۡلَصۡنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةࣲ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَیۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡیَارِ
kataKunci: Strength. Desires. Insight. Love. Country
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are seven (7) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Take a look at the characteristics of a successful person. Two: With a high standard of desires. Three: Having an insight – As Ulul Albaab. Four: Sincere in their tasks. Five: Love to purify themselves. Six: A deep sense of love for the country and hometown. Seven: Guides the family members to appear as an excellent family.
translit: wadzkur 'ibaadanaa 'ibraahiima wa'ishaaqa waya'quuba 'ulii l'aydii wal'absaari 'innaa 'akhlasnaahum bikhaalisatin dzikraa ddaari wa'innahum 'indanaa lamina lmustafayna l'akhyaari

title: The Rasuls Are Men
text: The Rasuls which We sent before you (Muhammad), were also human to whom We sent revelation. If you do not know this, then ask the people of the reminder.
arabic: وَمَاۤ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالࣰا نُّوحِیۤ إِلَیۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوۤا۟ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Male. Masculinity. Traits. Caliphs.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: God chose the masculinity trait. Two: Masculinity with abilities bring changes. Three: Life must be based on God's revelations - Kitabullah. Four: Always ready to be made as a referral point. Five: Willing to accept any questions raised – To portray wisdom in God's teachings.
translit: wamaa 'arsalnaa qablaka 'illaa rijaalan nnuuhii 'ilayhim fas'aluu 'ahla dzdzikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamuuna

title: Ask the Experts
text: Ask those who have the Reminder (the Ahlizzikr) if you do not know this fact yourself.
arabic: فَسۡـَٔلُوۤا۟ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Experts. Place. Ask. Expertise. Path for. Solutions
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Always ask. Two: Masculinity is aware of the ignorants. Three: The intelligent ones always ask. Four: Dig into three (3) useful things. Five: This makes a person appear as a proper human being - And will never get drifted away.
translit: fas'aluu 'ahla dzdzikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamuuna

title: The Path of Sustenance
text: Or is it that you are asking them for some recompense? But the recompense of your God is the best, for He is the best provider of sustenance.
arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجࣰا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَیۡرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَیۡرُ ٱلرَّ ٰزِقِینَ
kataKunci: Sustenance. Envelope. Evil. Wages. Best. God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand the term: Kharaja which refers to the the path of sustenance. Two: Kharaja comes from efforts. Three: Charity and wages do not reflect masculinity of sustenance. Four: Earnings received from efforts are the fruits of Kharaja - Only then can a person develop with his very own feet.
translit: 'am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru rraaziqiina

title: The Path of Sustenance
text: Or is it that you are asking them for some recompense? But the recompense of your God is the best, for He is the best provider of sustenance.
arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجࣰا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَیۡرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَیۡرُ ٱلرَّ ٰزِقِینَ
kataKunci: Sustenance. Hidden. Must. Exit. With. Easiness. Made into. A reality
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand the term: Kharaja which refers to the the path of sustenance. Two: Kharaja comes from efforts. Three: Charity and wages do not reflect masculinity of sustenance. Four: Earnings received from efforts are the fruits of Kharaja - Only then can a person develop with his very own feet.
translit: 'am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru rraaziqiina

title: Allah Completes His Affairs
text: Allah has set a measure for all things.
arabic: وَیَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَیۡثُ لَا یَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن یَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥۤۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَیۡءࣲ قَدۡرࣰا
kataKunci: Complete. Strength. Ability. God. Own. Perform. Tasks
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are six (6) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand about the strength of God and His Godliness. Two: Aware that God is beside – Near and close by. Three: God's strength by the mankind. Four: Put if efforts as long as a person can. Five: God goes all out to complete a task. Six: God displays His power to His servants – As an advantage for his servants in His eyes.
translit: wayarzuqhu min haytsu laa yahtasibu waman yatawakkal 'alaa llahi fahuwa hasbuhuu 'inna llaha baalighu 'amrihii qad ja'ala llahu likulli syay'in qadran

title: Do Tasks One by One, Place Your Hope in God
text: Therefore, when you are free from your daily task, devote your time to the labour of worship and turn all your attention towards your God. Place hope.
arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
kataKunci: Tasks. Must. In stages. God. Ought to. Placed hope
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand that every task is done in stages. Two: Understand that every stage has its very own arrangement. Three: Perform tasks one at a time until its completion. Four: God performs His task in six stages. Five: Surrender to Him - This leads to completeness.
translit: fa'idzaa faraghta fansab wa'ilaa rabbika farghab

title: God Is Near, Answering His Servants' Prayers
text: When My servants question you about Me, tell them that I am very close to them. I answer the prayer of every suppliant when he calls Me; therefore, they should respond to Me and put their trust in Me, so that they may be rightly guided.
arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِی عَنِّی فَإِنِّی قَرِیبٌۖ أُجِیبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡیَسۡتَجِیبُوا۟ لِی وَلۡیُؤۡمِنُوا۟ بِی لَعَلَّهُمۡ یَرۡشُدُونَ
kataKunci: God. Closeness. Allows. Togetherness. Prayers. Answered. Appear. Smart
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The smart ones are aware that God is nearby. Two: The smart ones are aware that God easily helps. Three: The smart ones are aware that God will definite answer to their prayers. Four: The smart ones are aware that they must believe in God – This will make God appear of use.
translit: wa'idzaa sa'alaka 'ibaadii 'annii fa'innii qariibun 'ujiibu da'wata ddaa'i 'idzaa da'aani falyastajiibuu lii walyu'minuu bii la'allahum yarsyuduuna

title: Everything Follows Allah's Way / All Affairs Are Handed Over to Allah
text: The Way of Allah, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. Beware! All affairs will eventually return to Allah.
arabic: صِرَ ٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِی لَهُۥ مَا فِی ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَمَا فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَاۤ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِیرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
kataKunci: Each. Every. Has. Path of. Norms. In line with. God's. Affairs
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are six (6) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand that everything has its stipulated method. Two: Understand about the existence the creation's method of norms. Three: Understand about man's path of desires. Four: Understand how to search for the achievement's path. Five: Understand that God remains with His undertaking's norms. Six: Understand that every task is performed for the sake of God - This makes a servant useful.
translit: siraati llahi lladzii lahuu maa fii ssamaawaati wamaa fii l'ardhi 'alaa 'ilaa llahi tasiiru l'umuuru

title: Efforts of Many Kinds
text: Surely your efforts are directed towards various ends.
arabic: إِنَّ سَعۡیَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
kataKunci: Efforts. For. Life. Various
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life must be accompanied with efforts. Two: Efforts come in various forms and ways. Three: Opportunities and efforts must be well balanced and equal - Only then will success be achieved.
translit: 'inna sa'yakum lasyattaa

title: The Hidden Comforts
text: No one knows what delights of the eye have been kept hidden for them as a reward for their good deeds (efforts).
arabic: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ مَّاۤ أُخۡفِیَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡیُنࣲ جَزَاۤءَۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ یَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Furqan. Hidden. Easiness. Source. Original. Must. Interpreted
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand about the hidden furqan. Two: Understand that furqan appears in two (2) forms. Three: One is created by by God as His norms's creations. Four: Another is discovered by man for their own use. Five: Understand that the task to create furqan is the task of God's as He observes man's efficiency undertaking tasks – A must to attain advancement once discovered..
translit: falaa ta'lamu nafsun mmaa 'ukhfiya lahum mmin qurrati 'a'yunin jazaa'a bimaa kaanuu ya'maluuna

title: Amthal, the Source of Furqan / The Gnat Ayat
text: Allah does not mind using the similitude of a gnat or an even more insignificant creature to teach a lesson. Those who believe, know that it is the truth from their God; but the unbelievers say: What does Allah mean by such a similitude? By such a similitude Allah confounds many and enlightens many, He confounds none except the transgressors
arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یَسۡتَحۡیِۦۤ أَن یَضۡرِبَ مَثَلࣰا مَّا بَعُوضَةࣰ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَیَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِینَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَیَقُولُونَ مَاذَاۤ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلࣰاۘ یُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِیرࣰا وَیَهۡدِی بِهِۦ كَثِیرࣰاۚ وَمَا یُضِلُّ بِهِۦۤ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَـٰسِقِینَ
kataKunci: Tiniest. Creation. God. Definitely. Generates. Form of. Furqan
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand that God creates the amthal resources of furqan. Two: Understand that furqan resources display the traits of: Bashaair. Three: Understand that everything contains furqan. Four: Understand that the believing in the existence of furqan – makes the mankind attain advancement. Five: Understand that not believing in such causes the furqan to become meaningless – Creativity develops the people.
translit: 'inna llaha laa yastahyii 'an yadhriba matsalan mmaa ba'uudhatan famaa fawqahaa fa'ammaa lladziina 'aamanuu faya'lamuuna 'annahu lhaqqu min rrabbihim wa'ammaa lladziina kafaruu fayaquuluuna maadzaa 'araada llahu bihaadzaa matsalan yudhillu bihii katsiiran wayahdii bihii katsiiran wamaa yudhillu bihii 'illaa lfaasiqiina

title: Allah Is With You
text: He (Allah) is with you wherever you are.
arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَیۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ
kataKunci: God. Closeness. With. His servants. No matter where. His servants. Are
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that God is close by. Two: Know that God is always with man. and He knows where the mankind is as there is God. Three: Know that God is nearby and so it is easy to ask for help. Four: Know that the task to feel God is nearby is actually a worship - It is important to feel that God is indeed nearby.
translit: wahuwa ma'akum 'ayna maa kuntum

title: God Is Near
text: We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
arabic: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَیۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِیدِ
kataKunci: God. Muhit. With. Man
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that God is extremely close by similar to the jugular vein in a person. Two: Understand of God's closeness similar to the close relationship between iron and a machete. Three: Understand the meaning of: Where there's iron, there's a machete – Inseparable. Four: Know that the machete (man) is a secret of the iron (God) – So the machete has to self reflect itself.
translit: wanahnu 'aqrabu 'ilayhi min habli lwariidi

title: Life Is Like Rain
text: Give them the similitude of the life (easiness) of this world. It is like the vegetation of the earth that flourishes with the rain from the sky, but afterwards the same vegetation turns into dry stubble which is blown away by the winds. Allah is the One Who has power over everything.
arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلۡحَیَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡیَا كَمَاۤءٍ أَنزَلۡنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاۤءِ فَٱخۡتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَصۡبَحَ هَشِیمࣰا تَذۡرُوهُ ٱلرِّیَـٰحُۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَیۡءࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرًا
kataKunci: Life. Easiness. Similar to. Wet. Dryness. Rain
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that life is similar to the rain water. Two: Know that life (rain water) is beneficial to the earth's surface (society and nation). Three: Understand that life (rain water) is able to liven up the earth's surface (develops the society). Four: Understand that if life (rain water) is blown with evil (wind that brings dryness), life (rain water) becomes meaningless - As there is always good things in life.
translit: wadhrib lahum mmatsala lhayawaati ddunyaa kamaa'in 'anzalnaahu mina ssamaa'i fakhtalata bihii nabaatu l'ardhi fa'asbaha hasyiiman tadzruuhu rriyaahu wakaana llahu 'alaa kulli syay'in mmuqtadiran

title: Call Upon Allah by His Beautiful Names
text: Say to them: Whether you call Him Allah or call Him Ar- Rahman' it is all the same by whichever name you call Him because for Him are all the finest names (Al asmaa’ul husna).
arabic: قُلِ ٱدۡعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدۡعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنَۖ أَیࣰّا مَّا تَدۡعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَاۤءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ
kataKunci: Prayers. Must. Be. Specific. Situation. Name. Officials. Determined
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that every prayer must be made in the name of God. Two: Know that everything that is asked for must be made in the name of God which is related to what that is being asked for. Three: Know the most popular name of God's that is encouraged by Him to be used while praying are Allah and Ar Rahman. Four: Know that the misuse of God's name during a prayer causes a prayer not answered – This means that the type of prayer and important name of God's must be given serious attention.
translit: quli d'uu llaha 'awi d'uu rrahmaana 'ayyan mmaa tad'uu falahu l'asmaa'u lhusnaa

title: Believers Are Given Love
text: Surely the Beneficent will bring about love for those who believe and do good deeds. Arrahman (The Compassionate) will bless them with love and care for one another.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَیَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنُ وُدࣰّا
kataKunci: Belief. Innovation. Close. Bound. Love. Caring.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that love and care are personal traits which practice the concept of the Godliness vision of: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihaat. Two: Economic wellbeing of the Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihaat people as a result from innovating economic innovation are able to generate A Caring society which fosters love and care for one another. Three: Understand that the term: Ar Rahmaanawudda – in terms of economic love and care for one another - Economy is the source of a caring society.
translit: 'inna lladziina 'aamanuu wa'amiluu ssaalihaati sayaj'alu lahumu rrahmaanu wuddan

title: Within Your Rights Are the Rights of Others
text: And share their wealth with the needy who asked for it, and those who did not ask.
arabic: وَفِیۤ أَمۡوَ ٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّاۤىِٕلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
kataKunci: Within. Rights. Exists. Rights. Of the other. And. Right. God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand the meaning of personal property. Two: Understand that within our rights lie rights of the others. Three: Understand that within our rights lie the rights of those who ask (beggars). Four: Understand that within our rights exist the rights of the destitute - They do not ask. Five: Understand that contributions made from our rights help purify the heart and wealth apart from obtaining blessings and prayers from the recipients – Caring is a form of strength.
translit: wafii 'amwaalihim haqqun llissaa'ili walmahruumi

title: Serve God Until Certainty
text: Worship your God until there comes to you which is certain.
arabic: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ یَأۡتِیَكَ ٱلۡیَقِینُ
kataKunci: Believing in God. Without. Faith. Disappointment. Confidence. Without. God. Insane
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know the meaning of servitude towards God. Two: Know the meaning of worshipping God. Three: Know the meaning of devotion towards God. Four: Know the meaning of having confidence in God. Five: Know that all three actions must be carried out with confidence as believing in God without confidence is illegitimate.
translit: wa'bud rabbaka hattaa ya'tiyaka lyaqiinu

title: For Man, Only What He Strives For
text: That there shall be nothing for a man except what he strives for, that his striving shall be scrutinized.
arabic: وَأَن لَّیۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ وَأَنَّ سَعۡیَهُۥ سَوۡفَ یُرَىٰ ثُمَّ یُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَاۤءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
kataKunci: Success. Efforts. Seen. God. As. Efforts. Core to. Success
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that man has no other choice but to put in efforts. Two: Know the meaning of success which reflects efforts. Three: Know that every effort will bring desired results. Four: Know that efforts and man can never be separated – Man is a nobody without efforts.
translit: wa'an llaysa lil'insaani 'illaa maa sa'aa wa'anna sa'yahuu sawfa yuraa tsumma yujzaahu ljazaa'a l'awfaa

textExtra.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense

title: Allah's Help, People Come in Multitudes
text: When there comes the help of Allah and the victory.
arabic: إِذَا جَاۤءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ
kataKunci: Help. Opportunities. Success
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand the terminologies of help and opportunities that serve as sources of success. Two: Understand the term: Help comes (An Nashru). Three: Understand the term: Opportunities of success that come (Al Fathu). Four: Aware that the presence of both generates success that enhances life. Five: Understand that help and opportunities of success must be sought and obtained.
translit: 'idzaa jaa'a nasru llahi walfathu

title: Allah's Help, People Come in Multitudes
text: When there comes the help of Allah and the victory, you see the people entering Allah's religion in multitudes
arabic: إِذَا جَاۤءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ وَرَأَیۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ یَدۡخُلُونَ فِی دِینِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰا
kataKunci: Presence. Multitudes. Symbol. Victory
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know whenever help and opportunities are present - Success or victory is in hand. Two: Understand the meaning of: Colours (sibghah) of success that would get enhanced and witnessed by the people. Three: Understand that the presence of people in multitudes in life is due to the person made exemplary – Success is witnessed by the people.
translit: 'idzaa jaa'a nasru llahi walfathu wara'ayta nnaasa yadkhuluuna fii diini llahi 'afwaajan

title: Allah's Help, People Come in Multitudes
text: When there comes the help of Allah and the victory, you see the people entering Allah's religion in multitudes. So glorify your God with His praises, and pray for His forgiveness: surely He is ever ready to accept repentance.
arabic: إِذَا جَاۤءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ وَرَأَیۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ یَدۡخُلُونَ فِی دِینِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰا فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
kataKunci: Victory. Praised. Self. Opponents. Realization. Offering. Hand. Forgiveness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that whenever victory is enhanced, people will visit in multitudes. Two: Understand that whenever a person receives praises and made exemplary, these are made into fine examples. Three: Understand the meaning of forgiving those who despised prior to achieving victory - Victory is praised by everyone.
translit: 'idzaa jaa'a nasru llahi walfathu wara'ayta nnaasa yadkhuluuna fii diini llahi 'afwaajan fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirhu 'innahuu kaana tawwaabaa

title: The Faces of Those at Ease / The Prosperous
text: Surely the righteous will be in bliss, reclining on soft couches, looking all around, and you will recognize in their faces the brightness of bliss.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِی نَعِیمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَاۤىِٕكِ یَنظُرُونَ تَعۡرِفُ فِی وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِیمِ
kataKunci: Easiness. Recognized. Blissful. Faces
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand the meaning of advantages of self achievement. Two: Understand that achievement leads to easiness. Three: Understand that self achievement is measured by the easiness experienced by a person. Four: Self achievement is measured by the height of ranks in life as well praises made by the people. Five: Self achievement is measured by a person's appearance which portrays easiness.
translit: 'inna l'abraara lafii na'iimin 'alaa l'araa'iki yanzuruuna ta'rifu fii wujuuhihim nadhrata nna'iimi

title: The Faces of Those at Ease / The Prosperous
text: Surely the righteous will be in bliss, reclining on soft couches, looking all around, and you will recognize in their faces the brightness of bliss. Their thirst will be quenched with the choicest sealed wine, and the seal will be of musk. Those who wish to excel above others, let them endeavor to excel in this. That shall have a mixture of tasnim, a spring, at which those nearest to Allah (muqarrabuun) will drink.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِی نَعِیمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَاۤىِٕكِ یَنظُرُونَ تَعۡرِفُ فِی وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِیمِ یُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِیقࣲ مَّخۡتُومٍ خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكࣱۚ وَفِی ذَ ٰلِكَ فَلۡیَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِیمٍ عَیۡنࣰا یَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
kataKunci: People. Easiness. Consume. Don. Expensive
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that a person's advantage lies in the easiness or hardship displayed by the appearance depicting a person's high standing and blissfulness. Two: Issues related to easiness are reflected by the usage of branded good. Three: Understand that the interest to race is always present in a person with advantages. Four: Easiness is shown by those with advantages through their drinking habits depicting class ad quality.
translit: 'inna l'abraara lafii na'iimin 'alaa l'araa'iki yanzuruuna ta'rifu fii wujuuhihim nadhrata nna'iimi yusqawna min rrahiiqin mmakhtuumin khitaamuhuu miskun wafii dzaalika falyatanaafasi lmutanaafisuuna wamizaajuhuu min tasniimin 'aynan yasyrabu bihaa lmuqarrabuuna

title: The One Wrapped in a Blanket
text: The one enveloped, stand up and warn!
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ
kataKunci: Weak. Fearful. Must. Stand up
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Always think about matters pertaining to sleep, sleeping under a blanket and weakness. Two: If weakness is experienced, the person has to stand up. Three: A person has to stand up to remind himself or herself to reject weaknesses - Classy and able.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lmuddatstsiru qum fa'andzir

title: The One Wrapped in a Blanket
text: The one enveloped, stand up and warn! Proclaim the greatness of your God, purify your clothes
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ وَثِیَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ وَٱلرُّجۡزَ فَٱهۡجُرۡ وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصۡبِرۡ
kataKunci: Glorify. God. Purify. Clothes
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember never to fall asleep, never to be enveloped with the blanket and never appear weak. Two: Reminders and waking up must be done based on God. Three: Stand up along with God and His greatness. Four: Stand up and be well dressed. Five: There is never the term weak or sloppy in life – Get dressed in neat clothes and righteousness.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lmuddatstsiru qum fa'andzir warabbaka fakabbir watsiyaabaka fatahhir warrujza fahjur walaa tamnun tastaktsiru walirabbika fasbir

textExtra.text: And uncleanliness avoid. And do not confer favor to acquire more. But for your Lord be patient.

title: The Later Is Better Than the Earlier
text: Certainly the later period shall be better for you than the earlier. Soon your God shall grant you something with which you will be well pleased.
arabic: وَلَلۡـَٔاخِرَةُ خَیۡرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَلَسَوۡفَ یُعۡطِیكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰۤ
kataKunci: Later. Things. Shall be. Better. From. The. Earlier
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life must never be static. Two: Civilization refers to changes and comfortable development. Three: The later must always be better than the earlier. Four: Things produced later must fulfill aspirations and satisfaction of the recipients as they receive the newer goods.
translit: walal'aakhiratu khayrun llaka mina l'uulaa walasawfa yu'tiika rabbuka fatardhaa

title: The Way of Life in the Sight of God
text: The only right way of life in the sight of Allah is to prosper (Islam).
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّینَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡإِسۡلَـٰمُۗ
kataKunci: Way of. Life. Norms. To prosper. Lost. Prosperity. Disaster
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that to prosper is a way of life chosen by God. Two: Prosperity leads to favours, blessings and rankings. Three: To prosper refers to peace and easiness. Four: Prosperity receives God's acceptance. Five: Prosperity exists in three (3) worlds – Living - death resurrection.
translit: 'inna ddiina 'inda llahi l'islaamu

title: Ibrahim's Testament to His Descendants / The Way of Life Chosen by God
text: This was the legacy that Ibrahim left to his sons and so did Ya’akub, when he said: O' my sons! Allah has chosen for you this way of life, therefore, die not unless you are Muslims.
arabic: وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَاۤ إِبۡرَ ٰهِـۧمُ بَنِیهِ وَیَعۡقُوبُ یَـٰبَنِیَّ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ ٱلدِّینَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
kataKunci: Action. Legacy. Ibrahim. Exemplary. Lineage. Mankind. Believing in God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the task to leave a legacy amongst the offsprings is obligatory. Two: The task to leave a legacy for the future generations to make prosperity as life's purpose is a must. Three: Remind the future generations never to die unless having achieved prosperity in life. Four: To prosper portrays God's life as a way of life of humans – that reflects Islam.
translit: wawassaa bihaa 'ibraahiimu baniihi waya'quubu yaabaniyya 'inna llaha stafaa lakumu ddiina falaa tamuutunna 'illaa wa'antum mmuslimuuna

title: Allah's Pattern and Colour of Life
text: Baptism is from Allah; and who is better than Allah in baptizing? Him do we worship.
arabic: صِبۡغَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ صِبۡغَةࣰۖ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ عَـٰبِدُونَ
kataKunci: Prosper. Way of. Life.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The best way of life is the one chosen and determined by God. Two: The way of life chosen by God suits with the life of His servants. Three: The prosperous way of life which generates prosperity is the way of life chosen by God – As the life of human beings.
translit: sibghata llahi waman 'ahsanu mina llahi sibghatan wanahnu lahuu 'aabiduuna

title: Why Not Ponder Upon the Al Quran?
text: Will they not ponder upon the Al Quran? Are there locks upon their hearts?
arabic: أَفَلَا یَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَاۤ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Heart. Locked. To. Ponder upon
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the Al Quran is be of no use if it is not pondered upon in the form of interpretation and deliberation Two: The heart that is locked from interpreting and deliberating the Al Quran causes man to behave as apes in the dense forests. Three: Reluctance of a person to interpret and deliberate the Al Quran causes the people to abandon the Al Quran – Causing life to appear without a direction.
translit: 'afalaa yatadabbaruuna lqur'aana 'am 'alaa quluubin 'aqfaaluhaa

title: The Prophet's Complaint: His People Abandoned the Al Quran
text: O' God of mine! Surely my people took this Al Quran for foolish nonsense.
arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ یَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِی ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورࣰا
kataKunci: Al Quran. Neglected. Turned into. Reality. Hadith. Importance. Al Quran. Abandoned
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember the prayer made by Prophet Muhammad to God is never a mockery. Two: Prayer made by Prophet Muhammad onto his prediction turned into a reality. Three: Prayer made by Prophet Muhammad portrayed his reaction towards his followers who over glorified him by implementing his Sunnah causing them to abandon the Al Quran. Four: The prayer and grievance reported by Muhammad to God was a warning of his towards the attitude displayed by his followers who mocked him with slander and falsehood - False hadith destroys the religion.
translit: waqaala rrasuulu yaarabbi 'inna qawmii ttakhadzuu haadzaa lqur'aana mahjuuran

title: Man Is in Loss
text: By the time through the ages! Surely mankind is in loss, except those who believe and do good deeds; exhort one another to the truth and exhort one another to patience.
arabic: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِی خُسۡرٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا۟ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡا۟ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
kataKunci: Loss. Man. Due to. Time
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that time is core to life. Two: Time, is not utilized to the maximum, life will face wastefulness. Three: Life will indeed be wasteful if it is not utilized for generating the Godly vision of: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihaat – Time is a platform for making a vision into a reality.
translit: wal'asri 'inna l'insaana lafii khusrin 'illaa lladziina 'aamanuu wa'amiluu ssaalihaati watawaasaw bilhaqqi watawaasaw bissabri

title: Man Is in Loss
text: By the time through the ages! Surely mankind is in loss, except those who believe and do good deeds; exhort one another to the truth and exhort one another to patience.
arabic: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِی خُسۡرٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا۟ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡا۟ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
kataKunci: Time. Capital. Life. Wasted. Time. Losses
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are six (6) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember the four (4) things that can make a person advantageous. Two: Man is advantageous is due to his belief. Three: Man is advantageous due to his innovative traits. Four: Man is advantageous when the truth is displayed in his actions. Five: Man is advantageous due to his patience. Six: Bear in mind that the vision of: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihat will not be present without the spirit to seek for the furqan's truth as well as patience.
translit: wal'asri 'inna l'insaana lafii khusrin 'illaa lladziina 'aamanuu wa'amiluu ssaalihaati watawaasaw bilhaqqi watawaasaw bissabri

title: Racing Towards Success
text: Cooperate with one another in righteousness and piety, and do not cooperate in sin and transgression.
arabic: وَتَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَ ٰنِۚ
kataKunci: Race. Good deeds. Prevent. Evil. Stay away from. Animosity. Closer. Righteousness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: To race in life. Two: Race to seek advantages. Three: Race to seek righteousness. Four: Race to prevent evil doings. Five: Race to avoid animosity. These are the attributes of the righteous.
translit: wata'aawanuu 'alaa lbirri wattaqwaa walaa ta'aawanuu 'alaa l'itsmi wal'udwaani

title: Within Your Rights Are the Rights of Others
text: Share their wealth with the needy who asked for it, and those who did not ask.
arabic: وَفِیۤ أَمۡوَ ٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّاۤىِٕلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
kataKunci: Within. Our rights. Exist. Rights. Of others
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the rights of others exist in ours. Two: Remember rights of others amongst the: As Saailiin (beggars). Three: Remember rights of others amongst the: Al Mahrum (the destitute). Four: Rights of others that mean rights of the government in the form of income tax. Five: The trait of knowing rights of others within ours leads to a caring society – Ar Rahmaana wudda.
translit: wafii 'amwaalihim haqqun llissaa'ili walmahruumi

title: Sadaqah Cleanses the Heart
text: Take sadaqah from their wealth, so that they may thereby be cleansed and purified, and pray for them; for your prayer will give the comfort. Allah hears all and knows all.
arabic: خُذۡ مِنۡ أَمۡوَ ٰلِهِمۡ صَدَقَةࣰ تُطَهِّرُهُمۡ وَتُزَكِّیهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَیۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّ صَلَوٰتَكَ سَكَنࣱ لَّهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِیعٌ عَلِیمٌ
kataKunci: Accept. Sadaqah. Responsibility. Cleanse. Wealth. The wealthy
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the rights of other exist within our rights. Two: The Saailiin (beggars) and Al Mahrum (the destitute) are urged to accept donations given by donors. Three: It is the responsibility of the donation recipients to pray for the donors' good deeds and blessings. Four: Those who donate part of their rights to others will have their hearts and wealth purified besides bringing happiness to themselves - In fact, happiness is felt by both parties.
translit: khudz min 'amwaalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkiihim bihaa wasalli 'alayhim 'inna salawaataka sakanun llahum wallahu samii'un 'aliimun

title: Distributing God's Mercy
text: Is it they who distribute the blessings of your God? It is We who distribute the means of their livelihood in the life of this world, raising some in rank above others, so that one may take others into his service. But the blessing of your God is far greater in value than the wealth of this world which they amass.
arabic: أَهُمۡ یَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَیۡنَهُم مَّعِیشَتَهُمۡ فِی ٱلۡحَیَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡیَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضࣲ دَرَجَـٰتࣲ لِّیَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضࣰا سُخۡرِیࣰّاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَیۡرࣱ مِّمَّا یَجۡمَعُونَ
kataKunci: Provide. Income. One. Livelihood. Share. Blessings. A. Responsibility
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the policy to of raising sustenance in certain people is based on the Godly sustenance. Two: Such policy helps spur economy. However, man has only a pair of hands whereas many hands are needed to complete several tasks. Three: Man's capability depends on his or her ability in many aspects as God rewards come in various forms. Four: The wealthy ones help the poor while the poor too help the wealthy ones in return as this is similar to the norms of the mountains and valleys. Mountains are noble due to their height while the valleys too are seen as noble due to their greenery.
translit: 'ahum yaqsimuuna rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamnaa baynahum mma'iisyatahum fii lhayawaati ddunyaa warafa'naa ba'dhahum fawqa ba'dhin darajaatin lliyattakhidza ba'dhuhum ba'dhan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mmimmaa yajma'uuna

title: Ocean Becomes Ink
text: Tell them: If the ocean were ink with which to write the words of my God, the ocean would surely be consumed before the words of my God are finished, even if We brought similar quantity of ink to replenish it.
arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادࣰا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّی لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّی وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدࣰا
kataKunci: Knowledge. Al Quran. As vast as. The ocean. Not. As narrow as. Eyes. Rewards
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the Al Quran is a vast ocean. Two: The Al Quran reflects the fine qualities of Bashaair (natural resources) that must be interpreted and deliberated. Three: Interpretation and deliberation of the Al Quran is never subjects o any form of aqidah. Four: The Al Quran is not a religious book, but a book of life's sibghah for the sake advancement in this world as well as the hereafter.
translit: qu llaw kaana lbahru midaadan llikalimaati rabbii lanafida lbahru qabla 'an tanfada kalimaatu rabbii walaw ji'naa bimitslihii madadan

title: The Hidden Comforts
text: No one knows what delights of the eye have been kept hidden for them as a reward (from God) for their deeds.
arabic: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ مَّاۤ أُخۡفِیَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡیُنࣲ جَزَاۤءَۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ یَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Furqan. Hidden. Must be. Interpreted
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that every amthal or Bashaair which reflects God's natural resources is mandatory to contain furqan. Two: Every form of furqan that exists in every amthal and bashaair remains hidden from the view of the mankind. However, they are entrusted to search and discover these. Three: The interpretation and deliberation processes as well as to interpret furqan resources until its discovery is made is crucial for the mankind's advancement.
translit: falaa ta'lamu nafsun mmaa 'ukhfiya lahum mmin qurrati 'a'yunin jazaa'a bimaa kaanuu ya'maluuna

title: Quick to Tell Others to Do Good, Yet Not Doing It
text: Would you ask others to be righteous and forget to practice it yourselves? Even though you read your Holy Book? Have you no sense?
arabic: ۞ أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
kataKunci: Intellectuals. Instruct. Others. Forget. Self
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The task to call and encourage people to do good deeds is an excellent trait when a person himself does good too. Two: The task to call and encourage people to do good deeds but at the same time, one forgets to do good is a trait admonished by God. Three: There are many intellectuals who love asking the others to do good but they themselves do not do it.
translit: 'ata'muruuna nnaasa bilbirri watansawna 'anfusakum wa'antum tatluuna lkitaaba 'afalaa ta'qiluuna

title: Much That Is Bad Attracts the Heart
text: Tell them: Bad and good are not equal, even though the abundance of the bad may dazzle you; so fear Allah, O' people of understanding (Ulul albab), that you may prosper.
arabic: قُل لَّا یَسۡتَوِی ٱلۡخَبِیثُ وَٱلطَّیِّبُ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَكَ كَثۡرَةُ ٱلۡخَبِیثِۚ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ یَـٰۤأُو۟لِی ٱلۡأَلۡبَـٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
kataKunci: Abundance. Falsehood. More. Beautiful. Than. The truth
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The good and the bad are completely different. Two: There are more bad things that appear as more beautiful than the truth. Three: Only the Ulul Albab who can easily differentiate between the evil and the good as they will only choose the good.
translit: qu llaa yastawii lkhabiitsu wattayyibu walaw 'a'jabaka katsratu lkhabiitsi fattaquu llaha yaa'ulii l'albaabi la'allakum tuflihuuna

title: Do Not Mix the Truth With Falsehood
text: Do not mix the truth with falsehood, or knowingly conceal the truth
arabic: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُوا۟ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُوا۟ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Never. Mix. The truth. With. Falsehood
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The truth and falsehood are completely different. Two: Never mix the truth with falsehood. Three: Never knowingly conceal the truth.
translit: walaa talbisuu lhaqqa bilbaatili wataktumuu lhaqqa wa'antum ta'lamuuna

title: Differences of Opinion / A New Invention Debated
text: About what are they asking? About the mighty event (presence of an invention) - the theme of their disputes. Very soon they shall come to know, We repeat, very soon, they shall come to know (development and making use of it).
arabic: ۞ عَمَّ یَتَسَاۤءَلُونَ عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِیمِ ٱلَّذِی هُمۡ فِیهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ كَلَّا سَیَعۡلَمُونَ ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَیَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Invention. New. Argued. Prior to. Put into use
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Everything new that is away from the norms will definitely be doubted upon. Two: Disputes in opinions and views carried out in discussions and arguments are surely to occur. Three: Numerous rejections towards the new will surely take place as such objections require a person who is presenting them to have endurance. Four: Numerous rejections received today will surely be put into use by the future generations.
translit: 'amma yatasaa'aluuna 'ani nnaba'i l'aziimi lladzii hum fiihi mukhtalifuuna kallaa saya'lamuuna tsumma kallaa saya'lamuuna

title: Not Everything You Dislike Is Bad
text: Fighting has been made obligatory for you, much to your dislike. It is quite possible that something which you don't like is good for you and that something which you love is bad for you. Allah knows, and you do not. Surah2: Al Baqarah:216
arabic: وَعَسَىٰۤ أَن تَكۡرَهُوا۟ شَیۡـࣰٔا وَهُوَ خَیۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَعَسَىٰۤ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَیۡـࣰٔا وَهُوَ شَرࣱّ لَّكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ یَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Numerous. Bad. Becomes. Good. Numerous. Good. Becomes. Bad
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that many things have occurred while the bad is claim as good. Two: Many things have occurred while the good is claim as bad. Three: There are numerous things considered as bad to the mankind while good in the eyes of God's. Four: There are also numerous things considered as good to the mankind while bad in the eyes of Allah Ta’ala's.
translit: wa'asaa 'an takrahuu syay'an wahuwa khayrun llakum wa'asaa 'an tuhibbuu syay'an wahuwa syarrun llakum wallahu ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamuuna

title: Fertile Land and Barren Land
text: The good soil yields rich produce by the permission of Allah and barren soil yields nothing but poor produce. Thus do We explain Our revelations over and over again for those who pay thanks.
arabic: وَٱلۡبَلَدُ ٱلطَّیِّبُ یَخۡرُجُ نَبَاتُهُۥ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِۦۖ وَٱلَّذِی خَبُثَ لَا یَخۡرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدࣰاۚ كَذَ ٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡـَٔایَـٰتِ لِقَوۡمࣲ یَشۡكُرُونَ
kataKunci: Greenery. Vegetation. Symbolises. Fertility. Land
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The colour green symbolises fertility. Two: Countries that are good are blessed with lush vegetation. Three: Countries that are bad are not blessed with the greenery of its lush vegetation. Four: Greenery symbolises the spirit of its citizens to attain advancement by flourishing the country's economic wellbeing.
translit: walbaladu ttayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhuu bi'idzni rabbihii walladzii khabutsa laa yakhruju 'illaa nakidan kadzaalika nusarrifu l'aayaati liqawmin yasykuruuna

title: Fertile Land and Barren Land
text: The good soil yields rich produce by the permission of Allah and barren soil yields nothing but poor produce. Thus do We explain Our revelations over and over again for those who pay thanks.
arabic: وَٱلۡبَلَدُ ٱلطَّیِّبُ یَخۡرُجُ نَبَاتُهُۥ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِۦۖ وَٱلَّذِی خَبُثَ لَا یَخۡرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدࣰاۚ كَذَ ٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡـَٔایَـٰتِ لِقَوۡمࣲ یَشۡكُرُونَ
kataKunci: Greenery. Vegetation. Symbolises. Colours. Country
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The colour green symbolises fertility. Two: Countries that are good are blessed with lush vegetation. Three: Countries that are bad are not blessed with the greenery of its lush vegetation. Four: Greenery symbolises the spirit of its citizens to attain advancement by flourishing the country's economic wellbeing.
translit: walbaladu ttayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhuu bi'idzni rabbihii walladzii khabutsa laa yakhruju 'illaa nakidan kadzaalika nusarrifu l'aayaati liqawmin yasykuruuna

title: Do Not Be Arrogant or Turn Your Face Away
text: Do not speak to the people with your face turned away, nor walk proudly on earth; for Allah does not love any self-conceited boaster.
arabic: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالࣲ فَخُورࣲ
kataKunci: Boastfulness. Must be. In moderation. Arrogance. Must be. In Moderation
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The act of turning the face away whenever meeting or talking is prohibited by Allah Ta’ala. Two: The act of walking on earth with overly happiness is prohibited by Allah Ta’ala. Three: The act of looking into the eyes whenever talking with a person is praised and approved by Allah Ta’ala. Four: The best akhlaq in a person lies in the eyes and moderation of behaviour.
translit: walaa tusa''ir khaddaka linnaasi walaa tamsyi fii l'ardhi marahan 'inna llaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhuurin

title: Everything Follows Allah's Way
text: The way of Allah - to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. Beware! All affairs will eventually return to Allah.
arabic: صِرَ ٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِی لَهُۥ مَا فِی ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَمَا فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَاۤ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِیرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
kataKunci: Path. Discovers. Secrets. God. Entire universe.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Everything that exists in the virtual orbit is created and moves according to its stipulated path. Two: All creations of God's are provided with the seven (7) paths. Three: Everything moves according to their paths being the fiscal path and respective methodologies. Four: If a path has been discovered, all tasks become easier and successful.
translit: siraati llahi lladzii lahuu maa fii ssamaawaati wamaa fii l'ardhi 'alaa 'ilaa llahi tasiiru l'umuuru

title: A Message of Thanks to Parents
text: We have enjoined man concerning his parents - his mother carries him in her womb while suffering weakness upon weakness and then weans him for two years. Give thanks to Me and to your parents, to Me is your final goal.
arabic: وَوَصَّیۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَ ٰلِدَیۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنࣲ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِی عَامَیۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِی وَلِوَ ٰلِدَیۡكَ إِلَیَّ ٱلۡمَصِیرُ
kataKunci: Exhaustion. Mother. Hardships. Father. Must be. Judged
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that their creation into this world is due to God and their parents. Two: Aware about the hardships endured by a mother during her pregnancy and weaning her children. Three: Know the values of serving parents is equivalent to the mankind serving God. Four: Gratefulness shown onto both parents and God are responsibilities of a child shown onto God and his or her parents.
translit: wawassaynaa l'insaana biwaalidayhi hamalathu 'ummuhuu wahnan 'alaa wahnin wafisaaluhuu fii 'aamayni 'ani sykur lii waliwaalidayka 'ilayya lmasiiru

title: Allah Does Not Change a Person's Fate
text: The fact is that Allah never changes the condition of the people until they change it themselves.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُغَیِّرُ مَا بِقَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ یُغَیِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡۗ
kataKunci: One. People. Changed. If. The people. Change themselves
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that the development of a race begins from one person amongst them. Two: Know that the importance of a person amongst the family who sparks colours of development's revolution of the people. Three: Know that capabilities of a race can function as the people's developmental revolution. Four: Know that God cannot generate furqan (a boat for example) from His creations except for the people themselves extract furqan (a boat from a piece of log) for the sake of their own and the people's development.
translit: 'inna llaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiruu maa bi'anfusihim

title: Allah Is the Best Planner
text: Allah also devised a plan and Allah is the best in planning.
arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَیۡرُ ٱلۡمَـٰكِرِینَ
kataKunci: God. Follows. Plannings. Man. With. Himself. The best. Planner
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Allah is God and He is the best Guardian and Planner. Two: Man must put in efforts but success or victory is determined by God. Three: Know that in life man must work hand in hand with God to make a task successful. Four: There are various tasks that cannot be carried out by man except for them done along with Allah Ta’ala. Five: If God does not participate in a certain task carried out by man, it would face failure. Failure similar to the building of confines and planting of tapioca if God does not participate together.
translit: wamakaruu wamakara llahu wallahu khayru lmaakiriina

title: Seek Help With Patience and Solat
text: O' you who believe! Seek My help with patience and prayer; surely Allah is with those who are patient.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسۡتَعِینُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِینَ
kataKunci: Help. God. Based. With. Prayer. Patience.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand that God's help is based on worshipping and asking for help. His help is easily obtained through establishing the solat. Two: God's help must be accompanied with patience. Three: Understand that man must do their part in completing their tasks (example: building confines and planting seedlings) before Allah Ta’ala completes His part (grows leaves, roots and tapioca bulbs). Four: Efforts come from man while success is delivered by God.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu sta'iinuu bissabri wassalawaati 'inna llaha ma'a ssaabiriina

title: Trust in Allah After Firm Resolve
text: When you make a decision, then put your trust in Allah. Allah loves those who put their trust in Him.
arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمۡتَ فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ یُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلِینَ
kataKunci: Decision. Symbol. Desires. Successful. God's. Requirements. Bestow.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A person will appear as dead if desires, determination and aspirations die in him. Two: Know that man must put in efforts to achieve their target of aspirations based on the task that is carried out. Three: Man must complete his part (building confines and planting seedlings) before Allah Ta’ala completes His part (grows leaves, roots and tapioca bulbs). Four: Know that man must put in efforts while God delivers them success.
translit: fa'idzaa 'azamta fatawakkal 'alaa llahi 'inna llaha yuhibbu lmutawakkiliina

title: Walking on the Face of the Earth
text: Have they not travelled through the land? Have they no hearts to learn wisdom, or ears to hear? Certainly it is not their eyes which are blind, but it is the hearts in their breasts which are blind.
arabic: أَفَلَمۡ یَسِیرُوا۟ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمۡ قُلُوبࣱ یَعۡقِلُونَ بِهَاۤ أَوۡ ءَاذَانࣱ یَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى ٱلۡأَبۡصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعۡمَى ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِی فِی ٱلصُّدُورِ
kataKunci: Life's. Journey. Sanity. Heart. Generates. A sound mind.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man's advantages are due to their sound mind and aqliah. If a sound mind is lost, man would appear as animals. Two: The mankind's hearts are able to produce a sound mind, meaning that aqliah does not lie in the head. Three: Know that the task to raise a person aqliah can only be done through the purification process according the wasilah path. Four: Know that the term: blind for Allah does not refer to the eyes but the heart. Five: Know that life must be based on the aqliah's ability generated by the heart. Knowledgeability and belief require aqliah and only then will man own ranks.
translit: 'afalam yasiiruu fii l'ardhi fatakuuna lahum quluubun ya'qiluuna bihaa 'aw 'aadzaanun yasma'uuna bihaa fa'innahaa laa ta'maa l'absaaru walaakin ta'maa lquluubu llatii fii ssuduuri

title: The Question of the Spirit
text: The put questions about A-Ruh (the spirit). Tell them: The spirit is at my God's command and I am not given any knowledge of it but a little.
arabic: وَیَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّی وَمَاۤ أُوتِیتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ إِلَّا قَلِیلࣰا
kataKunci: Life. Without. Spirit. Disastrous. Knowledge. A seedling. Planted. An entire plantation
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Know that a person is alive as long as the spirit remains within his or her body - otherwise, the person dies. Two: The spirit is Allah's secret and He is the secret. Three: The spirit is the work of God's as Allah is always with the spirit and is never separable no matter where a person is. Four: The spirit contains seedlings of knowledge (tiny and a little) and can be extended into a vast ocean of the Al Quran.
translit: wayas'aluunaka 'ani rruuhi quli rruuhu min 'amri rabbii wamaa 'uutiitum mmina l'ilmi 'illaa qaliilan

title: Sending the Rasul With Guidance
text: It is He who has sent His Rasul with Guidance and the religion of truth, so that He may exalt this religion over all other religions; and sufficient is Allah as a witness.
arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِیۤ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِینِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِیُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّینِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِیدࣰا
kataKunci: Overall. Way of. Actual. Life. Introduces. Allah. Through. His Rasul
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are six (6) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Rasul was sent as a messenger along with guidances. Two: Rasul was sent to bring along the true way of life (Addiin). Three: Rasul's presence was to introduce the way of life in accordance to the Godly norms. Four: Man is required to fully display life's guidances. Five: Man is required to portray the actual life. Six: Display two (2) of the life's elements that are discussed although these are much hated by the non believers.
translit: huwa lladzii 'arsala rasuulahuu bilhudaa wadiini lhaqqi liyuzhirahuu 'alaa ddiini kullihii wakafaa billahi syahiidan

title: Do Not Understand the Al Quran in Bits and Pieces
text: High and exalted be Allah, the True King. Do not hasten to recite the Al Quran before its revelation is completely conveyed to you, and then say: O' God of mine, increase my knowledge.
arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن یُقۡضَىٰۤ إِلَیۡكَ وَحۡیُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِی عِلۡمࣰا
kataKunci: Al Quran. Extremely. Vast. Never. Sufficient. Interpret. Single tiered
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran is interpreted by the Al Quran, where each and every verse of the Al Quran are interpreted by one or several other verses to validate the interpretation. Two: Never easily feel sufficient whenever verses are interpreted and deliberated without them being supported with explanations and deliberation by the other verses of the Al Quran. Three: Should there be darkness whenever interpreting and deliberating the Al Quran, one is advised to seek more knowledge and pray to God to have His knowledge borrowed and increased for the sake of completing the interpretation and deliberation tasks onto the Al Quran's in-depth knowledge.
translit: fata'aalaa llahu lmaliku lhaqqu walaa ta'jal bilqur'aani min qabli 'an yuqdhaa 'ilayka wahyuhuu waqu rrabbi zidnii 'ilman

title: Stories Are Ibrah / Lessons
text: There is a lesson in these stories for the men of common sense. It is not an invented tale, but a confirmation of previous scriptures - a detailed exposition of all things, and is a guidance and blessing for all the people who believe.
arabic: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِی قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةࣱ لِّأُو۟لِی ٱلۡأَلۡبَـٰبِۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِیثࣰا یُفۡتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصۡدِیقَ ٱلَّذِی بَیۡنَ یَدَیۡهِ وَتَفۡصِیلَ كُلِّ شَیۡءࣲ وَهُدࣰى وَرَحۡمَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ یُؤۡمِنُونَ
kataKunci: Tale. Shines. Past. Comparison. Direction. Forward
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Every tale and actual incident will become part of history. Two: Tales and incidents that take place contain lessons (exemplars and boundaries) for the future generation to learn from. Three: Every tale and incident is made a yardstick of comparison in terms of advancement or backwardness according relevance of time.
translit: laqad kaana fii qasasihim 'ibratun lli'ulii l'albaabi maa kaana hadiitsan yuftaraa walaakin tasdiiqa lladzii bayna yadayhi watafsiila kulli syay'in wahudan warahmatan lliqawmin yu'minuuna

title: God Bestows Mercy
text: We bestowed on them Our Mercy and We granted them the honour of being mentioned with true high respect.
arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِیࣰّا
kataKunci: Accept. Blessings. Name. Praised. Well known. Uttered
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A name is the first favour and blessing owned by a person when born into this world. A lifeless person is meaningless without a name. Two: The height of a person's standing in life depends on his or her name. If the name is remembered, the person's position shall be raised in the eyes of the world. Three: A name is a person's second self after death. As the Malay saying goes: Tigers die leaving behind their stripes and man dies leaving behind a name. Four: The best tombstone of remembrance is the name uttered by the people as a memorable past.
translit: wawahabnaa lahum mmin rrahmatinaa waja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyan

title: A Prayer for Good in This World and the Hereafter
text: But there are others who say: O' God of ours! Give us the good life, both in this world and in the hereafter and save us from the torment of fire. Such people shall have their due share according to what they have earned, Allah is swift in settling all accounts.
arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن یَقُولُ رَبَّنَاۤ ءَاتِنَا فِی ٱلدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِی ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ أُو۟لَـٰۤىِٕكَ لَهُمۡ نَصِیبࣱ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ۚ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِیعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
kataKunci: Good. Life. Must be. Sought. Hardships. Torments. Must be. Avoided.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life and its activities must be based on life that is good in this world as well as in the hereafter. Two: The way of life (sibghah) that appears on a targeted colour and purpose directly depends on the efforts and deeds that are put into practise. Three: The best way of life in this world and the hereafter must be strengthened and based on favours, blessings and prosperity.
translit: waminhum mman yaquulu rabbanaa 'aatinaa fii ddunyaa hasanatan wafii l'aakhirati hasanatan waqinaa 'adzaaba nnaari 'ulaa'ika lahum nasiibun mmimmaa kasabuu wallahu sarii'u lhisaabi

title: Everything Unseen Is Written in the Book
text: Nor there is any secret in the heaven and the earth which is not recorded in a clear Book.
arabic: وَمَا مِنۡ غَاۤىِٕبَةࣲ فِی ٱلسَّمَاۤءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا فِی كِتَـٰبࣲ مُّبِینٍ
kataKunci: Treasure. Trove. HIdden. In the Heavens. On earth. Written. In. Al Quran.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Not only do things physically exist in the Heavens and the earth, even the unseen are mentioned in the Al Quran. Two: The Al Quran is portrayed as a vast ocean, Heavens and the earth, where each one of them appear embedded in its verses, similar to the existence of a boat within a piece of log. Three: Every verse of the Al Quran portrays the traits of Bashaair or Amthal which needs to be interpreted or deliberated. In fact, each and every verse contains the seen and unseen along with their furqan for the mankind's life. Four: The task to interpret and deliberate the Al Quran is an obligation to the mankind.
translit: wamaa min ghaa'ibatin fii ssamaa'i wal'ardhi 'illaa fii kitaabin mmubiinin

title: Everything Has a Formula
text: Surely We have created everything in perfect ordainment (according to formulae). We command but Our will is done in the twinkling of an eye.
arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَیۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ وَمَاۤ أَمۡرُنَاۤ إِلَّا وَ ٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
kataKunci: Every. Creation. Exists. Through. Formulae. Expedites. Tasks
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Allah Ta’ala created things with formulae. Two: Once a formula is discovered, every related task becomes faster and can be accomplished in the twinkling of an eye. Three: The task of formulating a norm's formula is an innovation that must be performed by man for the sake of developing their lives.
translit: 'innaa kulla syay'in khalaqnaahu biqadarin wamaa 'amrunaa 'illaa waahidatun kalamhi bilbasari

title: Do It the Right Way, Heavy Rain Falls
text: If they had steadfastly followed the Right Way (formula), We would have certainly vouchsafed them abundant water.
arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِیقَةِ لَأَسۡقَیۡنَـٰهُم مَّاۤءً غَدَقࣰا
kataKunci: Everything. Exists. With. System. Formula
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that Allah Ta’ala creates things using formulae. Two: Whenever a formula is discovered, all tasks become easier. Even the rain can be created by man. Three: Search for the formula if a person or a race desires to attain advancement and feel the meaning of being developed.
translit: wa'allawi staqaamuu 'alaa ttariiqati la'asqaynaahum mmaa'an ghadaqan

title: Religious Life in Factions
text: Those who divide their religion and become separate groups, each group rejoicing in its own circle.
arabic: مِنَ ٱلَّذِینَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِینَهُمۡ وَكَانُوا۟ شِیَعࣰاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَیۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
kataKunci: Religion. Factions. Destroys. Religion. Hell. In hand. Man.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The act to separate the religion with a faction's aqidah destroys the religion. Two: The task of looking at the religion based on a faction's aqidah causes its followers and supporters of the faction to claim that only their aqidah is correct while the others are deviant, unbelievers and transgressors – Hell. Three: No matter how high or correct the is, if it is not based on the principles of the Al Quran, they must be avoided as they sway away from God's teachings based on the Al Quran.
translit: mina lladziina farraquu diinahum wakaanuu syiya'an kullu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihuuna

title: Spreading False Hadith
text: Among the people, there are some who purchase frivolous tales so that they may lead people away from the way of Allah, without any knowledge, and take it as a mockery. For such people there will be a humiliating punishment.
arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن یَشۡتَرِی لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِیثِ لِیُضِلَّ عَن سَبِیلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَیۡرِ عِلۡمࣲ وَیَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُو۟لَـٰۤىِٕكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِینࣱ
kataKunci: False. Hadith. Fake. News. Destroys. Religion. Life
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Every fake news is similar to the false hadith. It carried lies about Muhammad s.a.w who had been narrated by narrators - evil reporters, which have been widely accepted and used by the evil doers portrayed as a good intention. Two: The act of accepting any news without clarifying its authenticity is a trait of the Ummiyyuun (smart but not knowledgeable). such people accept whatever they hear and spread such news amongst the others who also blindly accept such falsehood that is presented. Three: Whenever a news is brought by a transgressor, check its authenticity. Otherwise, this could bring undesired consequences to the others. Always remember that no matter how high an aqidah can be but if it is not based on the Al Quran, it will still be considered deviant and as a false hadith.
translit: wamina nnaasi man yasytarii lahwa lhadiitsi liyudhilla 'an sabiili llahi bighayri 'ilmin wayattakhidzahaa huzuwan 'ulaa'ika lahum 'adzaabun mmuhiinun

title: Allah Buys the Believers' Selves and Wealth With Paradise
text: Indeed Allah has purchased from the believers their persons and their wealth and in return has promised them Paradise.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشۡتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِینَ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَمۡوَ ٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۚ
kataKunci: Allah. Purchases. Believers. from. The mankind
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: God conducts trade as He purchases the mukmin sold by the people. Two: God purchases the mukmin from persons and their wealth. Three: God purchases the mukmin with the price of Paradise.
translit: 'inna llaha sytaraa mina lmu'miniina 'anfusahum wa'amwaalahum bi'anna lahumu ljannata

title: Asking to Be Counted Among the Innovators
text: O' God of mine! Bestow wisdom upon me and admit me among the righteous, grant me a reputation of truthfulness on the tongue of later generations, count me among the inheritors of the paradise of bliss.
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِی حُكۡمࣰا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِی بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِینَ وَٱجۡعَل لِّی لِسَانَ صِدۡقࣲ فِی ٱلۡـَٔاخِرِینَ وَٱجۡعَلۡنِی مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِیمِ
kataKunci: Knowledgeable. Purpose. Life. Turns into. Innovation. Core. Life
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Wisdom is the spirit of knowledge. Without wisdom, knowledge will be of no use. Two: When a person dies, the best tombstone is the praises uttered by the people. Three: The best of all servants must inherit Paradise.
translit: rabbi hab lii hukman wa'alhiqnii bissaalihiina waj'a llii lisaana sidqin fii l'aakhiriina waj'alnii min waratsati jannati nna'iimi

title: Wealth and Children Benefit Those With Pure Hearts
text: The Day when neither wealth nor sons will avail anyone, except him who will come before Allah with a pure heart, when paradise shall be brought in the sight of the righteous.
arabic: یَوۡمَ لَا یَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِیمࣲ وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِینَ
kataKunci: Heart. Purified. More. Valuable than. Sons. Wealth
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The heart at the Qalbissalim level brings permanent benefits to man. Two: Children and wealth are beneficial in this world as long as the wealth is owned and the child is not deceased. Three: Purify the heart to the level of: Qalbissalim as this action reflects the religion's wasilah.
translit: yawma laa yanfa'u maalun walaa banuuna 'illaa man 'ataa llaha biqalbin saliimin wa'uzlifati ljannatu lilmuttaqiina

title: Determining One's Spouse for the Household
text: And of His signs, another one is that He created for you mates from among yourselves that you may find comfort with them, and He planted love and kindness in your hearts; surely there are signs in this for those who think about it.
arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَایَـٰتِهِۦۤ أَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَ ٰجࣰا لِّتَسۡكُنُوۤا۟ إِلَیۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَیۡنَكُم مَّوَدَّةࣰ وَرَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّ فِی ذَ ٰلِكَ لَـَٔایَـٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ یَتَفَكَّرُونَ
kataKunci: Life. With a spouse. Building. A family. Love and kindness. Enhances. Blessings
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Getting married is a must as life cannot be lived alone. Two: Life cannot be deprived of love and care. Hence, happiness and cheerfulness of blessings appear by having a spouse. Three: Life must be blessed with one's own generation as this lengthens a lineage's lifespan. Thus, the capital is the age of the lineage.
