translit: wamin 'aayaatihii 'an khalaqa lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaajan llitaskunuu 'ilayhaa waja'ala baynakum mmawaddatan warahmatan 'inna fii dzaalika la'aayaatin lliqawmin yatafakkaruuna

title: Do Not Be Arrogant or Turn Your Face Away
text: Do not speak to the people with your face turned away, nor walk proudly on earth; for Allah does not love any self-conceited boaster. Be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; for the harshest of voices is the braying of a donkey.
arabic: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالࣲ فَخُورࣲ وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِی مَشۡیِكَ وَٱغۡضُضۡ مِن صَوۡتِكَۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلۡأَصۡوَ ٰتِ لَصَوۡتُ ٱلۡحَمِیرِ
kataKunci: Turning away. Face. While. Talking. A symbol. Self. Being. Impolite
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The culture of the gentle eye meeting they eyes of another person is a culture made legacy amongst the people. Two: The act of turning away the eyes and cheeks while talking reflects arrogance in a person. Three: Boastfulness must be in moderation. Furthermore, the way a person walks and speaks with politeness reflects a humble soul.
translit: walaa tusa''ir khaddaka linnaasi walaa tamsyi fii l'ardhi marahan 'inna llaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhuurin waqsid fii masyyika waghdhudh min sawtika 'inna 'ankara l'aswaati lasawtu lhamiiri

title: Every Moving Creature Is Given Sustenance
text: There is no moving creature on earth whose sustenance is not provided by Allah. He knows its living and its resting place, and all that is recorded in a glorious Book.
arabic: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَاۤبَّةࣲ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَیَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلࣱّ فِی كِتَـٰبࣲ مُّبِینࣲ
kataKunci: Each. Everything. Moving. On earth. Source of. Allah's. Sustenance
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Sustenance comes from Allah for each and everything that exists in this virtual world. Two: Every sustenance resource has their respective locations and hiding places. Three: Every sustenance resource along with their respective locations and hiding places are mentioned in the Al Quran as an opportunity for man to search their life's furqan.
translit: wamaa min daabbatin fii l'ardhi 'illaa 'alaa llahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa kullun fii kitaabin mmubiinin

title: Every Moving Creature Is Given Sustenance
text: There is no moving creature on earth whose sustenance is not provided by Allah. He knows its living and its resting place, and all that is recorded in a glorious Book.
arabic: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَاۤبَّةࣲ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَیَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلࣱّ فِی كِتَـٰبࣲ مُّبِینࣲ
kataKunci: Each. Everything. Moving. On earth. Source of. Allah's. Sustenance
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Sustenance comes from Allah for each and everything that exists in this virtual world. Two: Every sustenance resource has their respective locations and hiding places. Three: Every sustenance resource along with their respective locations and hiding places are mentioned in the Al Quran as an opportunity for man to search their life's furqan. Four: Explore the Holy Scriptures of Allah's and the Al Quran as a source for Bashaair information - sustenance that comes along with them.
translit: wamaa min daabbatin fii l'ardhi 'illaa 'alaa llahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa kullun fii kitaabin mmubiinin

title: Turning Your Face to Witness God
text: I will turn my face; being upright, to Him who has created the heavens and the earth, and I am not one of the mushrikin.
arabic: إِنِّی وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِیَ لِلَّذِی فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِیفࣰاۖ وَمَاۤ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِینَ
kataKunci: Daily. Life. Face. Upright. God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that God is always beside man no matter where a person is. Two: Whenever God is beside a person. This means that the person is facing God. Therefore, matters pertaining to facing God must be given serious attention. Three: The act to cultivate the feeling of facing God must be flourished throughout a person's life as an everlasting remembrance towards Him. Four: One must never commit shirk against God.
translit: 'innii wajjahtu wajhiya lilladzii fatara ssamaawaati wal'ardha haniifan wamaa 'ana mina lmusyrikiina

title: 100% Submission to God
text: Surely my solat, my devotion, my life and my death are all for Allah, God of the worlds. He has no peer; thus am I commanded and I am the first of the Muslims.
arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ صَلَاتِی وَنُسُكِی وَمَحۡیَایَ وَمَمَاتِی لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَـٰلَمِینَ لَا شَرِیكَ لَهُۥۖ وَبِذَ ٰلِكَ أُمِرۡتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِینَ
kataKunci: Life. Everything. For. God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the four (4) elements must be given to God as a form of entrustment and responsibility of a servant towards God. Two: A person must establish solat - Witnessing in the form of good deeds - task for purifying the heart and as a symbol of being alive and demise - return to God. Three: One must also remember that to prosper is a Godly purpose of life and therefore such person must become one of the first to turn prosperity into life's purpose and must never commit shirk onto God.
translit: qul 'inna salaatii wanusukii wamahyaaya wamamaatii lillahi rabbi l'aalamiina laa syariika lahuu wabidzaalika 'umirtu wa'ana 'awwalu lmuslimiina

title: Why Not Ponder Upon the Al Quran?
text: Will they not ponder upon the Al Quran? Are there locks upon their hearts?
arabic: أَفَلَا یَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَاۤ
kataKunci: Heart. Locked. Once. Al Quran. Not. Pondered upon
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A person must ask himself why he was never nurtured to tadabbur the Al Quran. Two: A person must ask himself on the term: Iqrak (read) and why this term was performed only for the sake of obtaining rewards whilst having the willingness to be portrayed as a talking mynah. Three: Understand that the attributes of those with a locked heart should the person dislike and refuses to tadabbur the Al Quran. Four: A person must ask himself why he has not searched for a method to deliberate and interpret the Al Quran. If the ulamas deny having such methods, then do it on your own! This is because a vessel used for catching fish in the ocean was never invented by a venerated ulama (intellectuals of the apes and tortoises).
translit: 'afalaa yatadabbaruuna lqur'aana 'am 'alaa quluubin 'aqfaaluhaa

title: The Prophet's Complaint: His People Abandoned the Al Quran
text: The Rasul will say: O' God of mine! Surely my people took this Quran for foolish nonsense.
arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ یَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِی ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورࣰا
kataKunci: People. Abandoning. Al Quran. Predicament. Rasul
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: There are many people of Muhammad s.a.w who have abandoned the Al Quran. Two: There are many people of Muhammad who make use of external elements of the religion portrayed as Sunnah. Three: The act of making use of false hadith actually destroys and brings doom to the religion. Four: The act of allowing false hadith to rampantly spread without taking any steps to curb them causes ignorance in the religion while concealing the truth.
translit: waqaala rrasuulu yaarabbi 'inna qawmii ttakhadzuu haadzaa lqur'aana mahjuuran

title: Ocean Becomes Ink
text: Tell them: If the ocean were ink with which to write the words of my God, the ocean would surely be consumed before the words of my God are finished, even if We brought similar quantity to replenish it.
arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادࣰا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّی لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّی وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدࣰا
kataKunci: Knowledge. Al Quran. Vast. Without. Limits. Reality. God. Mocked.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran portrays the dense forest and vast ocean while its knowledge covers the Heavens and the earth. Two: The Al Quran is not the sole property of Islam and the Muslims. However, it is a universal property immaterial of race or religion. Three: The Al Quran and its knowledge's secrets are no longer the sole property of Islam as Muslims have shown their willingness to portray the traits of the apes in looking at Al Quran's beauty and treasures. Four: This is the golden opportunity that must be seized by the non-Muslims to explore deeply into the Al Quran.
translit: qu llaw kaana lbahru midaadan llikalimaati rabbii lanafida lbahru qabla 'an tanfada kalimaatu rabbii walaw ji'naa bimitslihii madadan

title: A Good Word Is Like a Good Tree
text: Do you not see Allah gave the example of comparing a good word with a good tree, whose roots are firm and its branches are in the sky? It yields its fruits in every season by Allah's leave. Allah cites these examples for men so that they may learn a lesson from them (the hint of ingredient).
arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَیۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلࣰا كَلِمَةࣰ طَیِّبَةࣰ كَشَجَرَةࣲ طَیِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتࣱ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِی ٱلسَّمَاۤءِ تُؤۡتِیۤ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِینِۭ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَیَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ یَتَذَكَّرُونَ
kataKunci: Kalimah. Good. Bears fruits. Meaning. As vast. The skies.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran is similar to the dense forest with lush vegetation growing high up into the skies as they look upon the vast blue ocean, inhaling the fresh air and receiving the sun. Two: Verses of the Al Quran are similar to the branches of tree in a dense forest. They may appear empty and covered with leaves, but they are similar to the blossoming flowers depicting furqan that needs to be discovered. This is the reason why the Al Quran is for those who are able to think.
translit: 'alam tara kayfa dharaba llahu matsalan kalimatan tayyibatan kasyajaratin tayyibatin 'asluhaa tsaabitun wafar'uhaa fii ssamaa'i tu'tii 'ukulahaa kulla hiini bi'idzni rabbihaa wayadhribu llahu l'amtsaala linnaasi la'allahum yatadzakkaruuna

title: Preaching Without Payment
text: Follow the ones who ask no reward of you and are rightly guided.
arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا یَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
kataKunci: Paid. Preachers. Religion. Are not. True preachers
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Religion is the property of God and are teaching and spreading the religion. If a servant of His accepts payment for preaching to spread the religion, the person will be deemed as being insincere towards God. Two: Preaching is not for earning a living as so acquiring religious knowledge - but is based on Godliness. Therefore, why doesn't a person hope for rewards from God? This is a dilemma of deception that must be overcome by the Godly preachers.
translit: attabi'uu man llaa yas'alukum 'ajran wahum mmuhtaduuna

title: The Furqan Revealed as a Reminder
text: Blessed is the One Who (God) has revealed Al Furqan (Quran) to His servant, that he may be a warner to the worlds.
arabic: ۞ تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِی نَزَّلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ لِیَكُونَ لِلۡعَـٰلَمِینَ نَذِیرًا
kataKunci: Al Furqan. Differentiates. The bad. The good. Claimed. At Taabi’in. Eyes. Eternity
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The term: furqan must be seen in two (2) tiers. (i): Furqan in the angle of differentiating between the good and the bad.. (ii): Furqan in the meaning of end product after the development's basic resources have been discovered and deliberated. Two: The Al Quran is a Book of knowledge and reminder for the entire universe and is not the sole property of Islam. Three: Discussions in the Al Quran are closely related to furqan and not with rewards. ‘Amilusshaalihaat cannot be generated by activities related to rewards, but can be generated by furqan from the discovery made from academic resources and activities of the mankind.
translit: tabaaraka lladzii nazzala lfurqaana 'alaa 'abdihii liyakuuna lil'aalamiina nadziiran

title: The Furqan Revealed as a Reminder
text: Blessed is the One Who (God) has revealed Al Furqan (Quran) to His servant, that he may be a warner to the worlds.
arabic: ۞ تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِی نَزَّلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ لِیَكُونَ لِلۡعَـٰلَمِینَ نَذِیرًا
kataKunci: Al Furqan. Opener. Secret. Resources. Development. Life. In the angle of. Contemporary
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The term: furqan must be seen in two (2) tiers. (i): Furqan in the angle of differentiating between the good and the bad.. (ii): Furqan in the meaning of end product after the development's basic resources have been discovered and deliberated. Two: The Al Quran is a Book of knowledge and reminder for the entire universe and is not the sole property of Islam. Three: Discussions in the Al Quran are closely related to furqan and not with rewards. ‘Amilusshaalihaat cannot be generated by activities related to rewards, but can be generated by furqan from the discovery made from academic resources and activities of the mankind.
translit: tabaaraka lladzii nazzala lfurqaana 'alaa 'abdihii liyakuuna lil'aalamiina nadziiran

title: Can the Al Quran Be Made Heard by the Deaf?
text: There are some among them who hear (reciting the Al Quran) what you say: but can you make the deaf listen to you, incapable as they are of understanding.
arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن یَسۡتَمِعُونَ إِلَیۡكَۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوۡ كَانُوا۟ لَا یَعۡقِلُونَ
kataKunci: Listening. Al Quran. Without. Aqliah. The deaf. Made to listen. Sounds
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Any element of change must never be disclosed to those who display the traits of the deaf without aqliah. Two: Even if such elements of change are disclosed, they would continue not believing (faith).
translit: waminhum mman yastami'uuna 'ilayka 'afa'anta tusmi'u ssumma walaw kaanuu laa ya'qiluuna

title: Can the Al Quran Be Shown to the Blind?
text: There are some among you who look at you; but can you show the way to the blind, bereft as they are of sight?
arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن یَنظُرُ إِلَیۡكَۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهۡدِی ٱلۡعُمۡیَ وَلَوۡ كَانُوا۟ لَا یُبۡصِرُونَ
kataKunci: Looking. Al Quran. As. Eyes. Blind. Not. Beneficial
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Any element of change must never be disclosed to those who display the traits of the deaf without aqliah. Two: Even if such elements of change are disclosed, they would continue not believing (faith).
translit: waminhum mman yanzuru 'ilayka 'afa'anta tahdii l'umya walaw kaanuu laa yubsiruuna

title: Warned or Not, It Is the Same to Those Who Reject
text: In fact, as for those who reject faith; it is the same, whether you warn them or you don't, they will not believe.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِینَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَیۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا یُؤۡمِنُونَ
kataKunci: Attitude. Refusal. Difficult. Accept. Changes.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: When a person is blind and deaf, it will be difficult for the person to accept elements of changes. Two: Even if such elements are notified to such people, they will still not believe.
translit: 'inna lladziina kafaruu sawaa'un 'alayhim 'a'andzartahum 'am lam tundzirhum laa yu'minuuna

title: Call to the Way of Your God
text: Call to the Way of your God with wisdom and best advice, and reason with them, in the most courteous manner; for your God knows best who strays from His Way and He knows best who is rightly guided.
arabic: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِیلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَـٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِی هِیَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِیلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِینَ
kataKunci: Wisdom. Lessons. Good. Arguments. Preaching. Wise. Towards. God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The act of calling towards God is an obligation. Two: Every call that is made must be based on wisdom. This refers to the benefits and advantages that can be obtained from what is being called for when a call is accepted. Three: Every call must be made wisely portraying valuable lessons. Four: Any doubt faced by the listeners must be clarified and in return present arguments in a pleasant manner. Five: Never force anyone to accept calls that are made as this must be done through their own realization.
translit: ad'u 'ilaa sabiili rabbika bilhikmati walmaw'izati lhasanati wajaadilhum billatii hiya 'ahsanu 'inna rabbaka huwa 'a'lamu biman dhalla 'an sabiilihii wahuwa 'a'lamu bilmuhtadiina

title: Asking for an Open Heart
text: Musa prayed: O' God of mine! Open my heart, ease my task and remove the impediment from my speech so that people may understand what I say.
arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِی صَدۡرِی وَیَسِّرۡ لِیۤ أَمۡرِی وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِی یَفۡقَهُوا۟ قَوۡلِی
kataKunci: Open. Heart. Tasks. Easier. Tongue. Fluent. People. Understand
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Before a task begins, ensure that the heart is calm. Never undertake a task when the heart is in a turmoil. Two: Tasks must be kept simple and find a way to ease tasks. Three: Whenever undertaking tasks, the tongue must be fluent and the language spoken must be clear. Four: Every explanation of calls that are made and explanations given to carry out tasks must be carried out in a clear manner so that they will be easily understood.
translit: qaala rabbi syrah lii sadrii wayassir lii 'amrii wahlul 'uqdatan mmin llisaanii yafqahuu qawlii

title: Seek Your Share of the Hereafter Without Forgetting Your Share of This World
text: Rather seek, by means on what Allah has given you, to attain the abode of the hereafter (wealth), while not neglecting your share in this world. Be good to others as Allah has been good to you, and do not seek mischief in the land, for Allah does not love the mischief mongers.
arabic: وَٱبۡتَغِ فِیمَاۤ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةَۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِیبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنۡیَاۖ وَأَحۡسِن كَمَاۤ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَیۡكَۖ وَلَا تَبۡغِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِینَ
kataKunci: Hereafter. Destination. World. Seen as. Good. Raised. Evil. Avoid.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The world is a place for man to invest for this world as well as for the hereafter. Two: Ignoring the world for the importance of this world as well as the hereafter causes a person to become a loser. Three: Life must be accompanied with drive to do good as how God does good onto you. Four: Never destroy the world with evil and catastrophes.
translit: wabtaghi fiimaa 'aataaka llahu ddaara l'aakhirata walaa tansa nasiibaka mina ddunyaa wa'ahsin kamaa 'ahsana llahu 'ilayka walaa tabghi lfasaada fii l'ardhi 'inna llaha laa yuhibbu lmufsidiina

title: The Parable of Deeds in Vain / The Mirage Ayat
text: As for the unbelievers, their deeds will disappear like a mirage in a sandy desert, which the thirsty traveller thinks to be water, but when he comes near, he finds it to be nothing, instead he finds Allah to settle his accounts - Allah is swift in settling accounts.
arabic: وَٱلَّذِینَ كَفَرُوۤا۟ أَعۡمَـٰلُهُمۡ كَسَرَابِۭ بِقِیعَةࣲ یَحۡسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمۡـَٔانُ مَاۤءً حَتَّىٰۤ إِذَا جَاۤءَهُۥ لَمۡ یَجِدۡهُ شَیۡـࣰٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِیعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
kataKunci: Sight. Dreams. Without. Norms. Success. Mirage
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life appears as a mirage if a person is deceived by his own eyes. Two: There are numerous mirages that appear before one's life and many get deceived. Three: An aspiration of easiness reflects the mirage when dreams are formed without the presence of efforts or diligence. Four: Investments made through assumptions without conducting feasibility studies reflect the mirage.
translit: walladziina kafaruu 'a'maaluhum kasaraabi biqii'atin yahsabuhu zzam'aanu maa'an hattaa 'idzaa jaa'ahuu lam yajidhu syay'an wawajada llaha 'indahuu fawaffaahu hisaabahuu wallahu sarii'u lhisaabi

title: Men Not Heedless, Though Busy Trading
text: Such people whom neither business nor business profit can divert from the remembrance of Allah, nor from establishing solat nor from paying zakah, for they fear the Day of Judgement when hearts will be overturned and eyes will be petrified.
arabic: رِجَالࣱ لَّا تُلۡهِیهِمۡ تِجَـٰرَةࣱ وَلَا بَیۡعٌ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِیتَاۤءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ یَخَافُونَ یَوۡمࣰا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِیهِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَـٰرُ لِیَجۡزِیَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَیَزِیدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ یَرۡزُقُ مَن یَشَاۤءُ بِغَیۡرِ حِسَابࣲ
kataKunci: Masculinity. Remembering. God. While. Dealing with. Masculinity. Godliness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Everyone who believes in God must have the masculinity spirit to be bold. Two: Portray masculinity when conducting trade and businesses as these face many challenges and obstacles and the solution is to be wise. Three: Masculinity in trade and businesses require God and those who believe in God as there are numerous things that cannot be done by man alone. However, these can be overcome with the help from God, mainly in the angle of sustenance. Four: Masculinity when conducting trade and businesses never neglects God despite the hecticness. Also, such people do not ignore performing their solat and contribute towards zakah. Five: Masculinity when conducting trade and businesses are extremely careful when facing days of uncertainty, especially when the economy is unstable and under threat.
translit: rijaalun llaa tulhiihim tijaaratun walaa bay'un 'an dzikri llahi wa'iqaami ssalawaati wa'iitaa'i zzakawaati yakhaafuuna yawman tataqallabu fiihi lquluubu wal'absaaru liyajziyahumu llahu 'ahsana maa 'amiluu wayaziidahum mmin fadhlihii wallahu yarzuqu man yasyaa'u bighayri hisaabin

textExtra.text: That Allah may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account.

title: Rasulullah, the Best to Follow
text: You have indeed, in the life of Rasulullah, the Best Model for him whose hope is in Allah and the Day of the Hereafter, and who engages himself much in the remembrance of Allah.
arabic: لَّقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِی رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ لِّمَن كَانَ یَرۡجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡیَوۡمَ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِیرࣰا
kataKunci: Rasuls. Fine examples. Best. Lessons
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Prophet Muhammad s.a.w was a person who portrayed the fine qualities of: Khuluqin ‘aziim (great personality) as he was sent to generate blessings for the entire universe being Uswatun hasanah. Two: Prophet Muhammad s.a.w, at all times throughout his rasulship acted upon policies of the Al Quran and there were no other policies, except for the Al Quran. The act of referring life's policies based on the Al Quran must be made as uswatun hasanah. Three: Prophet Muhammad s.a.w was an ardent follower of the past development philosophy of the rasulship civilization. He was presented with tales of success and achievement of the past rasulship civilizations to have them referred and renewed. This was mainly in terms of the past development's achievement that needs to be shown to the newer generations
translit: llaqad kaana lakum fii rasuuli llahi 'uswatun hasanatun lliman kaana yarjuu llaha walyawma l'aakhira wadzakara llaha katsiiran

title: The Family Life Ayat
text: Who pray: Our God! Make our wives and our children to be the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the righteous.
arabic: وَٱلَّذِینَ یَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَ ٰجِنَا وَذُرِّیَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡیُنࣲ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِینَ إِمَامًا
kataKunci: Wife. Children. Splendors. Vibrant. Life. Imam. Righteous
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A wife sparks love and kindness as she is the source of her family's happiness and excitement. With the presence of love and kindness, the home will be peaceful. Two: Presence of a wife will be incomplete without the presence of children that enhance the home. Three: Excitement in a home will surely exist if the purpose of love and kindness is created by the husband and expressed by the wife and children. This makes the family close-knit with love for one another.
translit: walladziina yaquuluuna rabbanaa hab lanaa min 'azwaajinaa wadzurriyyaatinaa qurrata 'a'yunin waj'alnaa lilmuttaqiina 'imaaman

title: If Desire Led the Truth
text: Had the truth followed their appetites, the heavens, the earth and everything therein would have been disrupted. Nay! We have given them their reminder, but they are heedless to their reminder.
arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَاۤءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِیهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَیۡنَـٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
kataKunci: If. Truth. Follows. The evil. The world. Destruction. Inhabitants. Destroyed
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Heavens and the earth and its inhabitants will get destroyed if the mankind is controlled by their desires. Two: The desire's violence is caused by man's very own violence, while calamities on land and in the seas are caused by man's soiled hearts. Three: The mankind's evil desires can only get killed by humanity that is generated from the heart's purification process performed through the wasilah path.
translit: walawi ttaba'a lhaqqu 'ahwaa'ahum lafasadati ssamaawaatu wal'ardhu waman fiihinna bal 'ataynaahum bidzikrihim fahum 'an dzikrihim mmu'ridhuuna

title: Seeking the Path of Wasilah
text: O' believers! Fear Allah and seek the means to be closer to Him and make struggle in His Way so that you may be successful.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبۡتَغُوۤا۟ إِلَیۡهِ ٱلۡوَسِیلَةَ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِی سَبِیلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
kataKunci: Path. Wasilah. Purifies. Heart. Closer. To. God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The wasilah path refers to the path of Godliness and the heart's purification. Two: The wasilah path is a path of Godly knowledge that successfully raises ranks of a person until the person's purified heart is acknowledged by Allah as a servant whom He pleases. Three: The wasilah path is a knowledge path that is chain-like from Allah Ta’ala – Jibrail a.s continued to Prophet Muhammad s.a.w and later continued to his companions and At taabi’iin until the mursyidin of today. Four: This is a path that must be sought while striving towards it.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu ttaquu llaha wabtaghuu 'ilayhi lwasiilata wajaahiduu fii sabiilihii la'allakum tuflihuuna

title: Rasulullah, the Best to Follow
text: You have indeed, in the life of Rasulullah, the 'Best Model' for him whose hope is in Allah and the Day of the hereafter, and who engages himself much in the remembrance of Allah.
arabic: لَّقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِی رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ لِّمَن كَانَ یَرۡجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡیَوۡمَ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِیرࣰا
kataKunci: Rasuls. Best. Example. Followed by. Man
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Attributes of Uswatun hasanah (the best example) refers to the advanced attributes of rasuls sent by God of the worlds. Two: Traits of backwardness and irrelevance in time must never be classified as Uswatun hasanah. Hence, turning the sand into a lavatory and using camels as mode of transportation are never considered as Uswatun hasanah. Three: Uswatun hasanah was not only portrayed by Prophet Muhammad. In fact, there were many other actions of Uswatun hasanah generated by the past prophets and rasuls similar to those mentioned in the Al Quran.
translit: llaqad kaana lakum fii rasuuli llahi 'uswatun hasanatun lliman kaana yarjuu llaha walyawma l'aakhira wadzakara llaha katsiiran

title: Do Not Repeat the Same Mistake
text: Allah admonishes you never to repeat a mistake like this, if you are true believers.
arabic: یَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثۡلِهِۦۤ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِینَ
kataKunci: Repent. Stop. Doing. Evil. Forever.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Repentance is a self confession where a person no longer wishes to repeat his past evil actions. Two: The Nashuha repentance is a self confession where a person no longer wants to partake in evil doings forever. Three: The Nashuha repentance is a form of repentance which cleanses one's self causing its doer to successfully stop from partaking in evil doings. In fact, such person abhors evil, non- belief and rebellion.
translit: ya'izukumu llahu 'an ta'uuduu limitslihii 'abadan 'in kuntum mmu'miniina

title: Innovators Inherit the Earth
text: We wrote this in The Zaboor after the reminder that as for the land, My righteous servants shall inherit it.
arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِی ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ أَنَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ یَرِثُهَا عِبَادِیَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
kataKunci: Earth. Inherited. Innovators. World. Without. Innovators. Backwardness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The world and the earth were created for the mankind to take necessary steps towards God's vision: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihat in the form of two (2) worshipping methods. Two: Presence of the mankind on this earth is replaceable, where the dead are replaced with the living. Therefore, matters pertaining to inheritors of the earth must be discussed. Three: God has laid His trust in His servants who are innovators (As Saalihin) only, having the ability to become inheritors of the earth. Believing in God without being able to bring development to one's self and the earth makes God of no use for creating the mankind - owing to the fact that the Angels had already existed if only for the purpose of glorifying Him.
translit: walaqad katabnaa fii zzabuuri min ba'di dzdzikri 'anna l'ardha yaritsuhaa 'ibaadiya ssaalihuuna

title: Every Nation Has Its Own Shari'ah
text: To every nation We have prescribed the rites of worship which they observe, therefore, let them not dispute with you concerning this matter - keep calling them to the way of your God; for most surely you are rightly guided.
arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكًا هُمۡ نَاسِكُوهُۖ فَلَا یُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِی ٱلۡأَمۡرِۚ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدࣰى مُّسۡتَقِیمࣲ
kataKunci: Every. Person. Has. Virtues. Own religion. Without. Ever. Being nullified
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Everyone is presented with a respective set of life's virtues created by God through the respective rasuls sent by Him. Two: Arrival of rasuls after the previous ones never nullifies virtues of the earlier rasuls. Three: Virtues of Muhammad s.a.w cannot nullify virtues of the earlier prophets and rasuls although Muhammad s.a.w is th seal of prophethood and rasulship. Therefore, followers of Muhammad must recognize virtues of the other religions without causing separation or animosity due to their set of virtues.
translit: llikulli 'ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan hum naasikuuhu falaa yunaazi'unnaka fii l'amri wad'u 'ilaa rabbika 'innaka la'alaa hudan mmustaqiimin

title: Follow Every Shari'ah That Is Set
text: We have put on you on the Right Way (Shari'ah) concerning the religion, so follow it, and do not yield to the desires of ignorant people.
arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَـٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِیعَةࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَاۤءَ ٱلَّذِینَ لَا یَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Islam. With. Islamic virtues. People. With. Their own. Virtues
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Religion of the believers (Islam) is along with their fine virtues, Religion of the Jews is with their respective virtues, and so are the religions of the Christians and Shaaibiin with their respective virtues which cannot interfere with the virtues of the other religions. Two: When the Al Quran commands the believers (Islam) to believe in the Holy Scriptures revealed by the previous rasuls, such fact presented by the Al Quran positions virtues of the past rasuls as the fine virtues of the Al Quran that cannot be invalidated by Islam. Therefore, contents of those Holy Scriptures including their fine virtues has become part of the Al Quran. It is a fact that the Al Quran will be deemed incomplete without the Holy Scriptures revealed by the past prophets (please refer this to the lawyers). Three: Muslims are reminded never to mock other religions for the fear that their religion will be mocked in return as worshipping deities is not only virtues of the non- Muslims. Even Islam worships the black box! So, it's best to keep mum over this issue as even the others have mouths to comment.
translit: tsumma ja'alnaaka 'alaa syarii'atin mmina l'amri fattabi'haa walaa tattabi' 'ahwaa'a lladziina laa ya'lamuuna

title: Every Land Has Its Wicked Chiefs
text: And that is why in every town We have placed criminals as their ring leaders to plot therein, they plot against none but their own souls, though they do not perceive it.
arabic: وَكَذَ ٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا فِی كُلِّ قَرۡیَةٍ أَكَـٰبِرَ مُجۡرِمِیهَا لِیَمۡكُرُوا۟ فِیهَاۖ وَمَا یَمۡكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا یَشۡعُرُونَ
kataKunci: Worst criminals. Ring leaders. When. Willingness. To. Cheat. Country
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: There are influentials and leaders of countries who have turned into ring leaders to do evil onto their country. Two: Whenever there is power or when a person feels powerful, opportunities are seized from these making such person not realize that his actions towards himself and the country are actually evil. Three: There have been many cases where those close to the influentials or leaders make use of them for their own personal agenda. Hence, such people do not realize that these activities are actually evil in nature.
translit: wakadzaalika ja'alnaa fii kulli qaryatin 'akaabira mujrimiihaa liyamkuruu fiihaa wamaa yamkuruuna 'illaa bi'anfusihim wamaa yasy'uruuna

title: Those Who Lose the Most
text: Tell them: Should we tell you the worst kind of losers relating to their deeds? Those whose all efforts in this worldly life had gone astray from the Right Way, but all along they were under the delusion that they were doing good deeds.
arabic: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِینَ أَعۡمَـٰلًا ٱلَّذِینَ ضَلَّ سَعۡیُهُمۡ فِی ٱلۡحَیَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡیَا وَهُمۡ یَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ یُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا
kataKunci: The worst kind of losers. Man. When. Wasting. Life. In this world
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The worst kind of losers are those who waste their lives in this world. Two: A person will be considered as a big loser in life when he leads a wasteful life. Three: A person will be considered as a big loser in life in this world if he fails to portray the Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihat vision. Four: A person will be considered as a big loser in life in this world if he engages in wasteful activities but considers them as doing good deeds.
translit: qul hal nunabbi'ukum bil'akhsariina 'a'maalan lladziina dhalla sa'yuhum fii lhayawaati ddunyaa wahum yahsabuuna 'annahum yuhsinuuna sun'an

title: The Al Quran in Arabic: Mother of All Books
text: We have revealed this Al Quran in the Arabic language so that you may understand. Surely it is a transcript of the Mother Book in Our keeping, which is sublime and full of wisdom.
arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَـٰهُ قُرۡءَ ٰنًا عَرَبِیࣰّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِیۤ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ لَدَیۡنَا لَعَلِیٌّ حَكِیمٌ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Arabic. Language. Mother. Of all. Books
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran was revealed for the smart and those who are able to think. In other words, those who refuse to become smart or to think must never assume the Al Quran as a book of life. Two: The Al Quran is Mother of all Books as its knowledge is as vast as the ocean while its interpretation depicted by its blueness fills the skies of life. Therefore, accept its wisdom, guidances and teachings.
translit: 'innaa ja'alnaahu qur'aanan 'arabiyyan lla'allakum ta'qiluuna wa'innahuu fii 'ummi lkitaabi ladaynaa la'aliyyun hakiimun

title: Prayers Swaying Up to the Sky
text: They will be running in terror with their heads uplifted, staring but seeing nothing and their hearts utterly vacant.
arabic: مُهۡطِعِینَ مُقۡنِعِی رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا یَرۡتَدُّ إِلَیۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَاۤءࣱ
kataKunci: Emptiness. Godliness. Prayers. Eyes. Staring. Into the sky.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Praying with the eyes gazing into the sky indicates such person is unaware where God is. Such person does not feel that God is indeed close by. Two: A sign that indicates void in a person's heart is when the person prays with his eyes gazing into the sky. Three: God's sublime attributes are never indicated as God resides in the skies. Therefore, if such antic is put into practice, change so that you will be able to feel that God is indeed close by.
translit: muhti'iina muqni'ii ru'uusihim laa yartaddu 'ilayhim tarfuhum wa'af'idatuhum hawaa'un

title: Grateful, Given More. Ungrateful, Punished.
text: Remember that your God had forewarned: If you are grateful, I will bestow abundance upon you, but if you are ungrateful, My punishment will be terrible indeed.
arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَىِٕن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِیدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَىِٕن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِی لَشَدِیدࣱ
kataKunci: Grateful. Increased. Disobedience. Punished
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Gratefulness encourages God to increase a person's sustenance. Thus, God is pleased as He knows that His servants are aware that such favours actually come from God. Two: Those who are ungrateful towards such favours bestowed by God feel that they are able to generate such sustenance on their own and not because of God. Such doers belong to the world of Qarun's torment which saw his wealth being swallowed.
translit: wa'idz ta'adzdzana rabbukum la'in syakartum la'aziidannakum wala'in kafartum 'inna 'adzaabii lasyadiidun

title: Allah's Favours Cannot Be Counted
text: He has given you all that you could ask for and if you want to count the favours of Allah, you will never be able to count them. In fact, man is unjust, thankless.
arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَاۤۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَظَلُومࣱ كَفَّارࣱ
kataKunci: Favours. God. Extremely. Plenty. Everything. Asked for. Servants. Granted
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man must see favours bestowed by God with gratefulness. Two: The act of counting God's favours received by a person is indeed a responsibility as value and number of favours seen and accumulated makes a person understand God's good deeds onto one's self.
translit: wa'aataakum mmin kulli maa sa'altumuuhu wa'in ta'udduu ni'mata llahi laa tuhsuuhaa 'inna l'insaana lazaluumun kaffaarun

title: Those Without Knowledge Assume Much
text: But they have no knowledge of it. They follow mere conjecture; and surely conjecture does not avail against the truth at all.
arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن یَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا یُغۡنِی مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَیۡـࣰٔا
kataKunci: Conjecture. Not. Based. Knowledge. Non. Beneficial. To. Truth
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Conjecture is a false desire that appears before life. Those with the: Ummiyyun stand are mere followers of what is being said. Two: Conjecture arises without investigating its authenticity and this tarnishes its relationship. The feeling of closeness becomes distant causing life's matters and pact unsuccessful.
translit: wamaa lahum bihii min 'ilmin 'in yattabi'uuna 'illaa zzanna wa'inna zzanna laa yughnii mina lhaqqi syay'an

title: Encouragement to Explore the Heavens and the Earth
text: O you, the assembly of jinns and men! If you have the power to get away from the boundaries of the heavens and the earth, then get away! You cannot get away except with Our Own authority
arabic: یَـٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَـٰنࣲ
kataKunci: Explore. The Heavens. Explore. The earth. Provide. Authority. Towards it.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Explorations require power as without power, explorations cannot be performed. Therefore, provide such power. Two: Explorations not only revolve around the earth, but also aspects that exist in the heavens. Sustenance too exists in the heavens. Therefore, open your eyes as wide as possible together with knowledge and capability's complete powers.
translit: yaama'syara ljinni wal'insi 'ini stata'tum 'an tanfudzuu min 'aqtaari ssamaawaati wal'ardhi fanfudzuu laa tanfudzuuna 'illaa bisultaanin

title: Lend Goodness to Allah, the Reward Is Multiplied
text: Who is the one that will give to Allah a goodly loan, so that He may increase it manyfold to his credit and give him a liberal reward besides it.
arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِی یُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰا فَیُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥۤ أَجۡرࣱ كَرِیمࣱ
kataKunci: God. Hopes. Loan. For. The mankind. God. Manifold
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Even God has several weaknesses that cannot be upgraded by Him as long as he remains as God. Two: As soon as God realized His weaknesses, He had no choice but to seek help from the mankind. If this is not done by Him, He would not be aware of His own advantages. Three: This made God desire advantages owned by the mankind and therefore requested for their help. God even has the willingness to borrow man's advantages for His advantage. Four: This proves on the sanctity of God's greatness as He cannot build a boat from a piece of log or taste the sweetness of the rambutans which are created by Himself.
translit: mman dzaa lladzii yuqridhu llaha qardhan hasanan fayudhaa'ifahuu lahuu walahuu 'ajrun kariimun

title: The Ayat Confirming the Existence of Hadith
text: With clear signs (bayyinat) and scriptures (Zaboor), and now We have sent down the reminder (Al Quran) to you so that you may explain clearly to the mankind as to what was sent to them so that they may think about it.
arabic: بِٱلۡبَیِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِۗ وَأَنزَلۡنَاۤ إِلَیۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَیِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَیۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ یَتَفَكَّرُونَ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Reminder. Path. Life. Muhammad. Commanded. Explained
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Hadith certainly exists along with the Al Quran to explain the Al Quran. Two: This is the verse which explains the birth of hadith and its importance when explaining the Al Quran. Three: Prophet Muhammad s.a.w was commanded by God to explain verses of the Al Quran to the mankind onto those verses that were not interpreted and deliberated by God through the concept of the Al Quran interprets the Al Quran. Four: Each and every interpretation and deliberation made onto verses of the Al Quran have their explanations made for those who can think.
translit: bilbayyinaati wazzuburi wa'anzalnaa 'ilayka dzdzikra litubayyina linnaasi maa nuzzila 'ilayhim wala'allahum yatafakkaruuna

title: The Task of Hadith: Explaining the Al Quran
text: We have revealed to you the Book (Al Quran) so that you may clearly explain to them the reality of those things in which they differ - it is a guidance and blessing for those people who believe.
arabic: وَمَاۤ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَیۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَیِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِی ٱخۡتَلَفُوا۟ فِیهِ وَهُدࣰى وَرَحۡمَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ یُؤۡمِنُونَ
kataKunci: Hadith. Overcomes. Disputes. Unites. The people. Prevents. Hostility
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Hadith do exist along with the Al Quran to elaborate the Al Quran. Two: This is the verse which explains the history of the hadith's existence and importance in explaining the Al Quran. Three: Prophet Muhammad s.a.w was commanded by God to explain the Al Quran verses to the mankind and those verses from the Al Quran that were yet to be interpreted and deliberated by God through the concept of the Al Quran interprets the Al Quran. Four: Each and every interpretation and deliberation performed onto the Al Quran verses is for the sake of overcoming disputes in terms of their discernment onto the Al Quran's statements.
translit: wamaa 'anzalnaa 'alayka lkitaaba 'illaa litubayyina lahumu lladzii khtalafuu fiihi wahudan warahmatan lliqawmin yu'minuuna

title: A Warning to the People of the Book: Do Not Go to Excess in Religion
text: Tell them: O' people of the Book (intellectuals)! Do not transgress the bounds of truth (Al Quran) in your religion, and do not yield to the fancies of those people who went astray before you. They misled many others and have themselves strayed away from the Right Way.
arabic: قُلۡ یَـٰۤأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ لَا تَغۡلُوا۟ فِی دِینِكُمۡ غَیۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوۤا۟ أَهۡوَاۤءَ قَوۡمࣲ قَدۡ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبۡلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِیرࣰا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَاۤءِ ٱلسَّبِیلِ
kataKunci: Excessive. Use. External. Elements. Rather than. Al Quran. Deviance
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Never exaggerate in religion. Never make use of elements that are not related to the religion to be transformed into religious elements as its truth only comes from the Al Quran. Two: False hadith, false literature and false independent reasoning are not elements of the religion. Never allow such insanity to find its place in the religion as practised by the fake pious people. Three: Ponder over this: Why are you still embracing the religion whereas food that has been tainted with filth is still permissible? Please ask yourselves.
translit: qul yaa'ahla lkitaabi laa taghluu fii diinikum ghayra lhaqqi walaa tattabi'uu 'ahwaa'a qawmin qad dhalluu min qablu wa'adhalluu katsiiran wadhalluu 'an sawaa'i ssabiili

title: Whispering in Goodness and Taqwa
text: O' believers! When you confer together in private, do not talk about sin and hostility and disobedience to the Rasul; but to counsel about virtue and piety; and fear Allah, before whom you shall be brought together.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوۤا۟ إِذَا تَنَـٰجَیۡتُمۡ فَلَا تَتَنَـٰجَوۡا۟ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَ ٰنِ وَمَعۡصِیَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَـٰجَوۡا۟ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِیۤ إِلَیۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
kataKunci: Whispering. Towards. The good. Never. Whisper. Towards. Evil doings.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Never whisper with friends in the presence of other friends as this leads to misconception. Two: Never whisper towards committing sin and hostility as such whispers are the act of satans.Three: Whisper towards the good and righteousness as such act encourages cooperation to achieve success for life's betterment.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu 'idzaa tanaajaytum falaa tatanaajaw bil'itsmi wal'udwaani wama'siyati rrasuuli watanaajaw bilbirri wattaqwaa wattaquu llaha lladzii 'ilayhi tuhsyaruuna

title: The Home of the People of Taqwa
text: When the righteous people are asked: What is it that your God has revealed? They say: That which is the best. Good is the reward for such righteous people in this world and the home of the hereafter will be even better. How splendid will be the home for the righteous.
arabic: ۞ وَقِیلَ لِلَّذِینَ ٱتَّقَوۡا۟ مَاذَاۤ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۚ قَالُوا۟ خَیۡرࣰاۗ لِّلَّذِینَ أَحۡسَنُوا۟ فِی هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَةࣱۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةِ خَیۡرࣱۚ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِینَ
kataKunci: Righteousness. Revealed. Good. The world. Platform. Good deeds. Eternity. The best. Place
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran and Allah’s Holy Scriptures were revealed together with goodness. Two: Guidances and teachings from Allah’s Holy Scriptures are basic references for life’s norms that reflect the good for those who desire doing good deeds. Three: Benefits from Allah’s teachings and guidances through His Holy Scriptures contain principles and philosophies for life’s advancement in this world as well as for the hereafter. Furthermore, the hereafter is far better for the righteous.
translit: waqiila lilladziina ttaqaw maadzaa 'anzala rabbukum qaaluu khayran llilladziina 'ahsanuu fii haadzihi ddunyaa hasanatun waladaaru l'aakhirati khayrun walani'ma daaru lmuttaqiina

title: Deceive Others, Torment Yourself
text: Do those who plot evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cave in the earth beneath them or that the scourge will not come to them from directions that they did not suspect?
arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِینَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّیِّـَٔاتِ أَن یَخۡسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ یَأۡتِیَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَیۡثُ لَا یَشۡعُرُونَ
kataKunci: Deception. People. Through. Evil. Self. Tormented. Unaware
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The act of displaying one’s intelligence through deception is indeed foolish. Two: The act of deception carried out by a person will be reciprocated by God in this world with humiliation. Three: God’s reciprocation onto the deceivers comes in two (2) forms: (i): Sustenance, favours and blessings owned by the deceivers get snatched away. (ii): Deceivers are tormented by God in such a way that is not realized by them whereas such torments are visible to the people.
translit: 'afa'amina lladziina makaruu ssayyi'aati 'an yakhsifa llahu bihimu l'ardha 'aw ya'tiyahumu l'adzaabu min haytsu laa yasy'uruuna

title: A Generation of Innovators, the Family's Aspiration
text: O’God of mine! Grant me a righteous child. So We gave him the good news of a gentle son (artistic innovation).
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِی مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِینَ فَبَشَّرۡنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِیمࣲ
kataKunci: Generation. Innovators. Aspirations. Family. Nation
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Creating an innovative family is an encouragement from God. Two: A race can attain development only from the birth of innovators as they are able to generate development and life’s civilization. Three: Praying for the bestow of a child as a form of innovation apart from cultivating innovation amongst the children is obligatory. Four: Birth of children as innovators in their families serve as a source of their family’s enhancement and happiness.
translit: rabbi hab lii mina ssaalihiina fabasysyarnaahu bighulaamin haliimin

title: A Prayer to Be Placed in Blessing
text: Say: O’ God of mine! Bless my landing from this ark, for You are the best to make my landing safe..
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِی مُنزَلࣰا مُّبَارَكࣰا وَأَنتَ خَیۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِینَ
kataKunci: Place. To reside. Place. To work. Must be. Ensured. Blissfulness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: There are blessings in the Heavens as well as on earth. Blessings on earth exist in designated spots and do not exist on random except as chosen by God. Two: The act of learning and acquiring knowledge in search of blessings and praying for blessings is an obligatory. Three: Both venues of blessings must be sought and obtained: (i): Residence and where a house is built (ii): Place for seeking sustenance, i.e a place to conduct businesses and agriculture. Four: Remember that believing in God and embracing the religion without determining a blissful place in life reflects foolishness.
translit: waqu rrabbi 'anzilnii munzalan mmubaarakan wa'anta khayru lmunziliina

title: The Exactness of Faith Will Be Tested
text: Do the people think that they will be left alone on saying: We believe, and that they will not be tested? We did test those who have gone before them. Allah has to see who are the truthful and who are the liars.
arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن یُتۡرَكُوۤا۟ أَن یَقُولُوۤا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا یُفۡتَنُونَ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِینَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَلَیَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِینَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَیَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡكَـٰذِبِینَ
kataKunci: Exactness. Needs. To be tested. Various. Confessions. Not. Affirmed
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Every confession made is impossible to be deemed as complete without being tested. Two: Confessing one’s belief in God will be impossible without testing its affirmation. Three: If the earlier generations were tested on their belief, would the newer generations be spared instead? The answer is no. It is definite to get tested.
translit: 'ahasiba nnaasu 'an yutrakuu 'an yaquuluu 'aamannaa wahum laa yuftanuuna walaqad fatannaa lladziina min qablihim falaya'lamanna llahu lladziina sadaquu walaya'lamanna lkaadzibiina

title: Honorary Satans
text: The disbelievers will say: Our God! Show us those among jinns and mankind who misled us; we shall trample them under our feet so that they become utterly disgraced.
arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِینَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَاۤ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَیۡنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ أَقۡدَامِنَا لِیَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِینَ
kataKunci: Jinns. Mankind. Honorary. Satans. Close. Enemies. God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The devil and satans not only belong amongst the Angels; but there are many more devils and satans amongst jinns and mankind. Two: Satans amongst the Angels and jinns need not be feared. Instead, fear satans amongst the mankind as they impersonate man for they are instead amongst the mankind. Three: Work of the satans, mainly the honorary satans, create people who disobey, not because they are disbelievers as this is only meant for the non- Muslims. Muslims cannot be considered as disbelievers despite them being more evil than the satans!
translit: waqaala lladziina kafaruu rabbanaa 'arinaa lladzayni 'adhallaanaa mina ljinni wal'insi naj'alhumaa tahta 'aqdaaminaa liyakuunaa mina l'asfaliina

title: Remember God in Your Heart
text: Bring your God to remembrance deep in your soul with humility and in reverence without raising your voice, both in the mornings and in the evenings; and be not of those who are heedless.
arabic: وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ فِی نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعࣰا وَخِیفَةࣰ وَدُونَ ٱلۡجَهۡرِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡـَٔاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡغَـٰفِلِینَ
kataKunci: Remember. God. In heart. Supplicate. In mouth. Gentle. Fearful. Voice
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The best remembrance of a person onto God is through khafi (hidden). Silence in the mouth – remembrance from the heart. Its sweet longing goes deep into the heart. Two: Remembering God whilst witnessing as in maqam: Numerous sights looking at one, while a single sight looks at many and a single sight onto the only one with a gentle loving heart. Follow up action: Read this once again
translit: wadzkur rrabbaka fii nafsika tadharru'an wakhiifatan waduuna ljahri mina lqawli bilghuduwwi wal'aasaali walaa takun mmina lghaafiliina

title: Revelation, Not Invention
text: When you do not bring them a revelation, they say: Have you not yet invented? Tell them: I follow only what is revealed to me from my God. This Book contains veritable insight from your God, a guidance and blessing for the true believers.
arabic: وَإِذَا لَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بِـَٔایَةࣲ قَالُوا۟ لَوۡلَا ٱجۡتَبَیۡتَهَاۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَاۤ أَتَّبِعُ مَا یُوحَىٰۤ إِلَیَّ مِن رَّبِّیۚ هَـٰذَا بَصَاۤىِٕرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدࣰى وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ یُؤۡمِنُونَ
kataKunci: Al Quran. God’s. Revelation. Not. Self creation. Muhammad. Explained. Al Quran
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Prophet Muhammad never practised his own Sunnah; instead, he followed the Al Quran Sunnah. On the contrary, Muhammad’s followers followed Muhammad’s Sunnah. In fact, they even created Muhammad’s Sunnah as they felt that the religion was insufficient solely with the Al Quran and its hadith without the presence of false hadith. Two: The act of making use of self created elements as elements of the religion are indeed ancient and must be avoided and made as a firm boundary. Should Prophet Muhammad embraced a religion of an incomplete recipe, the tongue will surely be able to taste the existing menú well and this is sufficient. However, food mixed with filth is never considered as food.
translit: wa'idzaa lam ta'tihim bi'aayatin qaaluu lawlaa jtabaytahaa qul 'innamaa 'attabi'u maa yuuhaa 'ilayya min rrabbii haadzaa basaa'iru min rrabbikum wahudan warahmatun lliqawmin yu'minuuna

title: The Dead Do Not Hear
text: Nor the living and the dead. Certainly Allah can make anyone hear if He so wills; but, you cannot make those who are in the graves hear you.
arabic: وَمَا یَسۡتَوِی ٱلۡأَحۡیَاۤءُ وَلَا ٱلۡأَمۡوَ ٰتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ یُسۡمِعُ مَن یَشَاۤءُۖ وَمَاۤ أَنتَ بِمُسۡمِعࣲ مَّن فِی ٱلۡقُبُورِ
kataKunci: Talqin. A. Transgression. Within. The religion. Exaggeration. Opposing. The Al Quran
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: When a person embraces a religion, he must know God, His prophets, faith and brotherhood. Nevertheless, these aspects must always remain in a person’s mind. Two: Embracing a religion must never allow a person to get fooled throughout his life despite establishing the solat but at the same time forgetting God’s name. Three: The practise of performing final rites (talqin) is indeed foolish which was self created by the religion’s deceivers as such act is against the Al Quran’s teachings.
translit: wamaa yastawii l'ahyaa'u walaa l'amwaatu 'inna llaha yusmi'u man yasyaa'u wamaa 'anta bimusmi'in mman fii lqubuuri

title: Seek Your Share of the Hereafter Without Forgetting Your Share of This World
text: Rather seek, by means of what Allah has given you, to attain the abode of the hereafter, while not neglecting your share in this world. Be good to others as Allah has been good to you, and do not seek mischief in the land, for Allah does not love the mischief mongers.
arabic: وَٱبۡتَغِ فِیمَاۤ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةَۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِیبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنۡیَاۖ وَأَحۡسِن كَمَاۤ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَیۡكَۖ وَلَا تَبۡغِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِینَ
kataKunci: Wealth. World. Purchased. Hereafter. Perform. Good deeds. Alike. Allah.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Rush to seek the world’s splendors for the world and rush to seek for the world’s splendors for the hereafter. Two: The world’s splendors will not be obtained here if they are not sought in this world itself while the hereafter’s splendors will not be obtained there if not sought in this world. Three: Do good as Allah does good onto you and never seek mischief in the world.
translit: wabtaghi fiimaa 'aataaka llahu ddaara l'aakhirata walaa tansa nasiibaka mina ddunyaa wa'ahsin kamaa 'ahsana llahu 'ilayka walaa tabghi lfasaada fii l'ardhi 'inna llaha laa yuhibbu lmufsidiina

title: See the Small World, Know the Great World
text: Have they not considered in their own minds that Allah created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them for a just reason and for a specific time? But the truth is that many among mankind do not believe in the meeting with their God.
arabic: أَوَ لَمۡ یَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِیۤ أَنفُسِهِمۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَیۡنَهُمَاۤ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّىۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِیرࣰا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَاۤىِٕ رَبِّهِمۡ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ
kataKunci: Look. Self. Understanding. Self. Seeing. The surrounding. As. Allah
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Why is it that matters concerning things that are present in a person made into initial basis for them to think? No matter how deep a person’s thinking is, thinking about what is present in a person must never be taken lightly – requires thinking. Two: Once a person is able to think well about his own and realizes that he is actually God’s well kept secret, he should then think about God’s creations for the sake of man’s development. Three: Thinking back that everything created by God is through stipulated formulae, so seek for those formulae and explore such resources that have been bestowed by Him.
translit: 'awa lam yatafakkaruu fii 'anfusihim mmaa khalaqa llahu ssamaawaati wal'ardha wamaa baynahumaa 'illaa bilhaqqi wa'ajalin mmusamman wa'inna katsiiran mmina nnaasi biliqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiruuna

title: Turning Your Face to Witness God
text: I will turn my face, being upright, to Him who has created the heavens and the earth, and I am not one of the mushrikin.
arabic: إِنِّی وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِیَ لِلَّذِی فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِیفࣰاۖ وَمَاۤ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِینَ
kataKunci: Facing. Understanding. Self. Before. God
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember that the task of witnessing and facing God all the time is an obligation. The heart witnesses and faces God and this must be felt by a person all the time, whether during or outside the solat times. Two: Prostrating before God and loving Him are attributes that must be nurtured by a person and never to commit shirk against Him ever.
translit: 'innii wajjahtu wajhiya lilladzii fatara ssamaawaati wal'ardha haniifan wamaa 'ana mina lmusyrikiina

title: 100% Submission to Allah
text: Declare: Surely my solat, my devotion, my life and my death are all for Allah, God of the worlds. He has no peer; thus am I commanded and I am the first of the Muslims.
arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ صَلَاتِی وَنُسُكِی وَمَحۡیَایَ وَمَمَاتِی لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَـٰلَمِینَ لَا شَرِیكَ لَهُۥۖ وَبِذَ ٰلِكَ أُمِرۡتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِینَ
kataKunci: Every. Action. Must be. Submitted. To. God. For. Evaluation
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Remember about the four (4) matters that must be submitted to God, i.e. solat, worship, life and death. Two: Solat, worship, life and death will become meaningless if a person commits shirk against God. Three: Always be reminded that the task of becoming the first person to attain prosperity is an obligatory pledge made by a person before God.
translit: qul 'inna salaatii wanusukii wamahyaaya wamamaatii lillahi rabbi l'aalamiina laa syariika lahuu wabidzaalika 'umirtu wa'ana 'awwalu lmuslimiina

title: The Al Quran Revealed, Explained in Many Ways
text: Tell them: Surely I am only a plain warner. The warning which We sent down to the schismatics, the one who divided their Al Quran into separate parts. So by your God, We will question them all about their doings.
arabic: وَقُلۡ إِنِّیۤ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِیرُ ٱلۡمُبِینُ كَمَاۤ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِینَ ٱلَّذِینَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِینَ فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِینَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ یَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Ummul kitab. Revealed. Onto. Everyone. Explained. Various
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran was revealed to various types of people who can be classified into three (3) groups: (i): Various types of people in terms of race, language and speech. (ii): Various types of people according to knowledge and its depth. iii): Various types of people in the angle of the Al Quran’s knowledge that is to be explored and pondered upon. Two: The Al Quran is Mother of all Books and can be segregated and elaborated due to its vastness without limitations. Three: God awaits man to act upon the Al Quran for the sake of their development and Godliness.
translit: waqul 'innii 'anaa nnadziiru lmubiinu kamaa 'anzalnaa 'alaa lmuqtasimiina lladziina ja'aluu lqur'aana 'idhiina fawarabbika lanas'alannahum 'ajma'iina 'ammaa kaanuu ya'maluuna

title: Asking for Tough Things Beyond the Norms
text: Surely I fear about my relatives after me, for my wife is barren, grant me an heir by Your Grace who should inherit me and inherit the prosperity of Ya’akub, and make him a desirable person.
arabic: وَإِنِّی خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَ ٰلِیَ مِن وَرَاۤءِی وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِی عَاقِرࣰا فَهَبۡ لِی مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِیࣰّا یَرِثُنِی وَیَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ یَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِیࣰّا
kataKunci: Ask. From. God. Tough. Things. Beyond. The. Norms
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Believing in God is for the sake of asking help for things that cannot be done one’s own Hence, if such things can be done, the need for praying will no longer arise. Two: Praying means to ask for things that are tough and beyond the norms. So, if rambutans were to easily appear before one’s doorstep, there will no longer be any need for them to pray for it. Three: Whenever asking for things that are beyond the norms, prayers made will be answered. It is then when a person sees God and feels the need to show gratefulness. Four: Nostalgia originates from things that are difficult to be obtained. Therefore, seek for such nostalgia from God by praying for things that are difficult to be obtained.
translit: wa'innii khiftu lmawaaliya min waraa'ii wakaanati mra'atii 'aaqiran fahab lii min lladunka waliyyan yaritsunii wayaritsu min 'aali ya'quuba waj'alhu rabbi radhiyyan

title: Musa Samiriy, Father of False Hadith
text: And Samiriy forged a calf in the shape of a body which produced the mooing sound. Then they cried out: This is your God and the God of Musa, but Musa forgot to mention it to you.
arabic: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلࣰا جَسَدࣰا لَّهُۥ خُوَارࣱ فَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَاۤ إِلَـٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِیَ
kataKunci: Samiriy. Father. False. Hadith. Musa. Deceived. Harun. Disappointed
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Era of the false hadith was reflected during Musa As Samiry’s time where it created words supposedly uttered by the rasul (false hadith) which saw the truth appear beside its falsification. Two: Falsification by As Samiry (false hadith) was widely accepted by the people causing their ruler (Harun a.s) to keep mum on As Samiry’s deception (Ustaz Al Baqarah).
translit: fa'akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadan llahuu khuwaarun faqaaluu haadzaa 'ilaahukum wa'ilaahu muusaa fanasiya

title: Man, Khalifah on the Face of the Earth
text: Then, We made you their successors in the land so that We may observe how you would conduct yourselves.
arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَـٰكُمۡ خَلَـٰۤىِٕفَ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لِنَنظُرَ كَیۡفَ تَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Tasks. Caliphs. On. Earth. Witnessed. God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The mankind reflects Allah’s caliphs and at the same time, they are also innovators and inheritors of the earth. Whenever the world caliphs is mentioned, it is obligatory for a person to become innovators who inherit the earth. Two: Allah’s caliphs, innovators and inheritors of the earth are replaceable as the old are replaced by the younger generation. Three: Every action of the newer caliphs depicting their own and the society’s advancement will be observed by God as being relevant, developed and successful.
translit: tsumma ja'alnaakum khalaa'ifa fii l'ardhi min ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'maluuna

title: Hearts Tremble When Allah's Name Is Mentioned
text: The true believers are those whose hearts tremble with fear, when the name of Allah is mentioned, and whose faith grows stronger as they listen to His revelations and they put their trust in their God.
arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِینَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَإِذَا تُلِیَتۡ عَلَیۡهِمۡ ءَایَـٰتُهُۥ زَادَتۡهُمۡ إِیمَـٰنࣰا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ یَتَوَكَّلُونَ
kataKunci: Hearts. Tremble. Due to. Knowing. Symbolizing. Closeness. And. Nearby.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The feeling of spontaneous trembling in the heart is made a yardstick to measure one’s love for God. Allah Ta’ala is always beside man and touches the pulse of His servants whenever their tongues utter His name or recite His holy verses. Two: The heart trembles whenever a person utters His name or whenever reciting His holy verses and this is made as a yardstick portraying one having the awareness that God is indeed close by. Three: Stronger trembles are felt whenever God’s name is uttered or whenever His holy verses are recited. This reflects the firmness of a person’s faith towards God Who is beside such person.
translit: 'innamaa lmu'minuuna lladziina 'idzaa dzukira llahu wajilat quluubuhum wa'idzaa tuliyat 'alayhim 'aayaatuhuu zaadathum 'iimaanan wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaluuna

title: Determine Wisdom Before Knowledge
text: He grants wisdom (useful knowledge) to whom He pleases; and whoever is granted wisdom is indeed given a great wealth, yet none except people of understanding learn a lesson from it.
arabic: یُؤۡتِی ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ مَن یَشَاۤءُۚ وَمَن یُؤۡتَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ فَقَدۡ أُوتِیَ خَیۡرࣰا كَثِیرࣰاۗ وَمَا یَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّاۤ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلۡأَلۡبَـٰبِ
kataKunci: Wisdom. Must be. Determined. First. Prior to. Knowledge. Acquisition.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Wisdom is the capability of knowledge. Two: Those who own knowledge with wisdom shall obtain loads of benefits. Three: Acquiring knowledge that cannot be determined of its wisdom shall make a person a loser. Therefore, always ensure that you are aware of the wisdom that will be obtained prior to learning or acquiring knowledge.
translit: yu'tii lhikmata man yasyaa'u waman yu'ta lhikmata faqad 'uutiya khayran katsiiran wamaa yadzdzakkaru 'illaa 'uluu l'albaabi

title: Love, a Treasure of Godliness
text: Through putting affection in their hearts, if you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have so united their hearts; but Allah has united them. He is Mighty and Wise.
arabic: وَأَلَّفَ بَیۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ لَوۡ أَنفَقۡتَ مَا فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِیعࣰا مَّاۤ أَلَّفۡتَ بَیۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَیۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِیزٌ حَكِیمࣱ
kataKunci: Affection. Love. Wealth. Life’s. Treasures. Godliness.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Love and affection for one another in a family unit and society serves as a main form of wealth for them. Two: Love and affection comes with a high price and cannot be purchased with any form of wealth that exists in the heavens and the earth. Three: Creating love and affection between a husband and his wife as well as amongst the entire family is the role and responsibility of parents. Meanwhile, creating love and affection among members of the society is the responsibility of their leaders.
translit: wa'allafa bayna quluubihim law 'anfaqta maa fii l'ardhi jamii'an mmaa 'allafta bayna quluubihim walaakinna llaha 'allafa baynahum 'innahuu 'aziizun hakiimun

title: Wealth and Children Benefit Those With Pure Hearts
text: The Day when neither wealth nor sons will avail anyone, except him who will come before Allah with a pure heart.
arabic: یَوۡمَ لَا یَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِیمࣲ
kataKunci: Wealth. Children. Not. Useful. Except. Well prepared. Purified. Heart.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The purified heart is capital and wealth for the hereafter. Wealth is able to generate life’s ranks in Paradise apart from qualifying a person to face God. Two: Wealth and children can only help a person as long as wealth is still owned by one’s self while the children can help both parents as long as the children are still living. Help rendered by wealth and children are seasonal whereas the heart is for ever lasting.
translit: yawma laa yanfa'u maalun walaa banuuna 'illaa man 'ataa llaha biqalbin saliimin

title: Save Yourselves and Your Families From the Hellfire of Hardship
text: O believers! Save yourselves and your families from hellfire, whose fuel is men and stones, in the charge of fierce and mighty angels who never disobey Allah’s command and who promptly do what they are commanded to do.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوۤا۟ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِیكُمۡ نَارࣰا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَیۡهَا مَلَـٰۤىِٕكَةٌ غِلَاظࣱ شِدَادࣱ لَّا یَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَاۤ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَیَفۡعَلُونَ مَا یُؤۡمَرُونَ
kataKunci: Hellfire. Hardships. Weakness. Must be. Avoided. Befall. Self. Family.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Hell refers to hardships and sufferings where it exists in this world as well as in the hereafter. Two: The task of making sufficient preparations for life in this world and the hereafter is obligatory. A person and his family must ensure being granted with Paradise and easiness. Three: Heat in life originates from two (2) sources: (i): Heat from the hellfire due to friction between one another that originates from the competition in search for food. (ii): Heat from the hellfire due to life’s hardships that originates challenges that kills one’s capabilities and patience causing people to face disappointment and inability to cope such predicaments in life.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu quu 'anfusakum wa'ahliikum naaran waquuduhaa nnaasu walhijaaratu 'alayhaa malaa'ikatun ghilaazun syidaadun llaa ya'suuna llaha maa 'amarahum wayaf'aluuna maa yu'maruuna

title: Empty of Hearing and Aqliah, Becoming Animals
text: Or do you think that most of them listen or try to understand? They are nothing but animals – nay, they are even further off the track!
arabic: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ یَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ یَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَـٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِیلًا
kataKunci: Listening. Aqliah. Traits. Mankind. Meaningless. Reflecting. Animals.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The trait of listening and thinking reflects a person’s humanity. If both traits fail to exist, man will appear as animals – or even worst than them. Two: Matters pertaining to listening, thinking and seeing are three aspects that must be looked into by the mankind if they desire to become true human beings.
translit: 'am tahsabu 'anna 'aktsarahum yasma'uuna 'aw ya'qiluuna 'in hum 'illaa kal'an'aami bal hum 'adhallu sabiilan

title: The Best Person Calls to God
text: Who is better in speech than the one who calls people towards Allah, does good deeds and says: I am a Muslim.” Surah 41: Fussilat:33
arabic: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلࣰا مِّمَّن دَعَاۤ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحࣰا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِی مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِینَ
kataKunci: Best. Person. Calls. Man. Towards. Innovation. Believing in God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The best of all words and calls are made onto the following two (2) matters: (i): Calling towards Allah and (ii): Calling towards innovation reflecting God’s vision of: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihat. Two: The act of acknowledging self as prosperity’s explorer and to obtain prosperity is an obligation amongst those who believe in God.
translit: waman 'ahsanu qawlan mmimman da'aa 'ilaa llahi wa'amila saalihan waqaala 'innanii mina lmuslimiina

title: The Fitrah Way of Life, Prosperous
text: Surely the only Deen in the sight of Allah is Al-Islam.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّینَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡإِسۡلَـٰمُۗ
kataKunci: Way of. Life. Norms. Prosperous. Purpose. Prosperous. Life.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A person’s way of life must be based on the concept of prosperity as there’s nothing higher than prosperity. Two: The task involved to ensure prosperity exists in life come through three (3) aspects of time, i.e. to prosper in life, to prosper in death and to prosper during resurrection.
translit: 'inna ddiina 'inda llahi l'islaamu

title: Commanded to Serve With Sincerity
text: Say: I am commanded to worship Allah and serve none but Him and I am commanded to be the first who submit to Allah in Islam.
arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّیۤ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصࣰا لَّهُ ٱلدِّینَ وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِینَ
kataKunci: Believing in God. Sincerity. In. Life. Leads to. One of the. First. Prosperous.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Each and every individual is commanded to believe in Allah whilst practising sincerity in their Godly way of life (religion). Two: Each and every individual is commanded to become the first person to make prosperity as life’s policy and purpose.
translit: qul 'innii 'umirtu 'an 'a'buda llaha mukhlisan llahu ddiina wa'umirtu li'an 'akuuna 'awwala lmuslimiina

title: The Fitrah Way Perfected, Favour by His Side
text: Today I have perfected your religion for you, completed my favour upon you and approved Al-Islam as a Deen for you.
arabic: ٱلۡیَوۡمَ أَكۡمَلۡتُ لَكُمۡ دِینَكُمۡ وَأَتۡمَمۡتُ عَلَیۡكُمۡ نِعۡمَتِی وَرَضِیتُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡإِسۡلَـٰمَ دِینࣰاۚ
kataKunci: Prosperity. Way of. Life. Favours. Perfected. In. Life.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The way of life is complete and must be accepted as a complete way of life when it is based on Allah’s Holy Scriptures and the Al Quran. Two: Favours prepared by God are sufficient for life and to create life’s civilization. Elaboration and interpretation of furqan must be carried out by the mankind. Three: The concept of a prosperous life is surely accepted by God.
translit: alyawma 'akmaltu lakum diinakum wa'atmamtu 'alaykum ni'matii waradhiitu lakumu l'islaama diinan
