title: In Hardship, Bow Down. In Ease, Forget.
text: Man is such that when he is in trouble he appeals to us; but when We bestow Our favour upon him, he says: this has been given to me because of certain knowledge I possess. Nay! It is but a test yet most of them do not know.
arabic: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَـٰهُ نِعۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَاۤ أُوتِیتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِیَ فِتۡنَةࣱ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا یَعۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Difficult. Prostrate. Easily. Ignored. God’s. Bestow. Belittled
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man easily forgets especially during hardships, he immediately remembers God. However, when easiness appears, he begins to ignore God. Two: The knowledgeables easily forget themselves when success is achieved from their efforts. Their eyes become blind in seeing God. In fact, their success and favours are claimed to have come from their knowledge. This was how Qarun was punished by God as his favours got blinded in seeing God.
translit: fa'idzaa massa l'insaana dhurrun da'aanaa tsumma 'idzaa khawwalnaahu ni'matan mminnaa qaala 'innamaa 'uutiituhuu 'alaa 'ilmi bal hiya fitnatun walaakinna 'aktsarahum laa ya'lamuuna

title: Hold Fast to the Rope of Allah
text: All together hold fast to the rope of Allah and be not divided among yourselves. Remember Allah’s favours upon you when you were enemies; He united your hearts; so by His favour you became brethren.
arabic: وَٱعۡتَصِمُوا۟ بِحَبۡلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِیعࣰا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا۟ۚ وَٱذۡكُرُوا۟ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَیۡكُمۡ إِذۡ كُنتُمۡ أَعۡدَاۤءࣰ فَأَلَّفَ بَیۡنَ قُلُوبِكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم بِنِعۡمَتِهِۦۤ إِخۡوَ ٰنࣰا وَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفۡرَةࣲ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنۡهَاۗ كَذَ ٰلِكَ یُبَیِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَایَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
kataKunci: Grip. Allah’s. Rope. Unite. Never. Divide. Under. His favours
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man must firmly hold onto Allah’s rope and never grip any other rope besides Allah’s. Hence, whenever Allah’s rope is mentioned, one must understand that Allah’s rope refers to His Holy Scriptures and the Al Quran. Two: Whenever holding onto Allah’s rope, one must always grip it entirely. Partially holding onto the Al Quran and onto the others will be considered incomplete, depicting as mixing food with dirt. Three: Never cause separation within the religion that is based on the belief of factions. Factions consisting of friends is considered as right while the others as deviant. Such unscrupulous culprits claim that Paradise is reserved for their own faction while the rest belong to hell (This is the reason for having so many Malaysians inhabit Paradise – on the condition that they belong to a certain political party).
translit: wa'tasimuu bihabli llahi jamii'an walaa tafarraquu wadzkuruu ni'mata llahi 'alaykum 'idz kuntum 'a'daa'an fa'allafa bayna quluubikum fa'asbahtum bini'matihii 'ikhwaanan wakuntum 'alaa syafaa hufratin mmina nnaari fa'anqadzakum mminhaa kadzaalika yubayyinu llahu lakum 'aayaatihii la'allakum tahtaduuna

title: Truth Destroys Falsehood
text: We give falsehood a violet blow with the truth to knock it out and behold! Falsehood vanishes away. Woe be to you, for all the false gods you have invented.
arabic: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَـٰطِلِ فَیَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقࣱۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَیۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
kataKunci: Arrival. Truth. Destroys. Falsehood
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Evil shall face defeat to the truth. Filth from such evil can only be cleansed with the truth. Therefore, whenever the truth appears before the evil, it will surely erode and destroy strength of the evil. Two: The truth is never considered as democracy as casting votes blindly is never the same as casting them wisely. At such memento, truth requires patience and courage, whereas courage lies in the stomach. This is owing to the fact that there are many stomachs that conceal the truth when it is fed with such food.
translit: bal naqdzifu bilhaqqi 'alaa lbaatili fayadmaghuhuu fa'idzaa huwa zaahiqun walakumu lwaylu mimmaa tasifuuna

title: The Al Quran Nurtures People to Be Smart
text: Say: It has been revealed to me that a band of jinns listened (to the Al Quran) and said: We have heard a wonderful Al Quran which guides to the right way. We have believed in it and henceforth shall worship none besides our God.
arabic: ۞ قُلۡ أُوحِیَ إِلَیَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوۤا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰا یَهۡدِیۤ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَاۤ أَحَدࣰا
kataKunci: Al Quran. Nurtures. People. Becoming. Smart.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Embracing the religion same as the religion of Prophet Ibrahim is indeed a smart move. Those who refuse to embrace Ibrahim’s religion are indeed foolish. Whereas his religion is a religion of prosperity based on the Holy Scriptures of Allah’s and the Al Quran. Two: Gist of the Al Quran’s guidance and teachings lead the mankind towards becoming smart. This means that is the Al Quran is amongst the foolish similar to the apes’ civilization, they will never achieve any progress. This encouraged the smart human beings to explore the apes’ civilization. This is how the Al Quran is made legacy by the non- Muslims as the Muslims tend to glorify the apes’ civilization in the quest of fulfilling their hunger for Paradise.
translit: qul 'uuhiya 'ilayya 'annahu stama'a nafarun mmina ljinni faqaaluu 'innaa sami'naa qur'aanan 'ajaban yahdii 'ilaa rrusydi fa'aamannaa bihii walan nnusyrika birabbinaa 'ahadan

title: Do Not Insult What Others Worship
text: Do not insult those whom these mushrikin call upon besides Allah, lest in retaliation they call bad names to Allah out of their ignorance. Thus We have made the deeds of every group of people seem fair to them. In the end they will all return to their God and then, He will inform them of the reality of all that they have done.
arabic: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا۟ ٱلَّذِینَ یَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَیَسُبُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَدۡوَۢا بِغَیۡرِ عِلۡمࣲۗ كَذَ ٰلِكَ زَیَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَیُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ یَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Worshipping. God. According to. Respective. Virtues. Acknowledging. Authenticity.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Never insult worshipping of the others or they shall insult our in retaliation. Two: Everyone has their very own virtues. Therefore, never insult their virtues or they shall insult our in return.
translit: walaa tasubbuu lladziina yad'uuna min duuni llahi fayasubbuu llaha 'adwaa bighayri 'ilmin kadzaalika zayyannaa likulli 'ummatin 'amalahum tsumma 'ilaa rabbihim mmarji'uhum fayunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanuu ya'maluuna

title: Firm Leadership
text: We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgement in speech and decision.
arabic: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَیۡنَـٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
kataKunci: Firm. Leadership. During. Leaders. Own. Wisdom. Fluent. Speech
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The tongue signifies strength. Knowledge’s advantages and wisdom cannot be presented to the public should the tongue be reluctant for doing so. Two: Strength of a leader depends on his speech. As such, his pattern and approach would fail from being presented to the people if the tongue becomes reluctant.
translit: wasyadadnaa mulkahuu wa'aataynaahu lhikmata wafasla lkhitaabi

title: The Al Quran Made Easy for Those Who Want Reminding
text: We have indeed made the Al Quran very easy to understand the admonition, so is there any who would take admonition?
arabic: وَلَقَدۡ یَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Book. Teachings. Reason. Ignored. Its importance.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran is easy. It is easy to understand and easily put into practise in life, especially with the concept of the Al Quran interprets the Al Quran is put into use in understanding its teachings’ ingredient. Two: The act to make the Al Quran difficult to be understood makes it appear as gold before the apes. Gold fails to be valued or interpreted by the apes despite it being invaluable.
translit: walaqad yassarnaa lqur'aana lidzdzikri fahal min mmuddakirin

title: Save Yourselves and Your Families From the Hellfire of Hardship
text: O believers! Save yourselves and your families from hellfire.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوۤا۟ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِیكُمۡ نَارࣰا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَیۡهَا مَلَـٰۤىِٕكَةٌ غِلَاظࣱ شِدَادࣱ لَّا یَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَاۤ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَیَفۡعَلُونَ مَا یُؤۡمَرُونَ
kataKunci: Life. Enters. Hell. If. Humanity. Attributes. Are not. Preserved.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Hell exists in this world and in the hereafter. Therefore, seek for the world’s Paradise for this world and the world’s Paradise for the hereafter. Two: In life, never position yourselves in hell which refers to the world of hardships and sufferings. Hence, find for the way for yourself and your family to appear in the world of Paradise and easiness.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu quu 'anfusakum wa'ahliikum naaran waquuduhaa nnaasu walhijaaratu 'alayhaa malaa'ikatun ghilaazun syidaadun llaa ya'suuna llaha maa 'amarahum wayaf'aluuna maa yu'maruuna

title: The Al Quran: Teaching, Cure and Guidance for the Devout
text: O mankind! There has come to you an instruction from your God, a cure for whatever is in your hearts, a guidance and a blessing for the true believers.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَاۤءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَشِفَاۤءࣱ لِّمَا فِی ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدࣰى وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِینَ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Teachings. Cure. Guidance. Blessings. For the. Devout believers.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran mentions about the four (4) ingredients for life: (i): Teachings. (i): Cure for the soul and illnesses. (iii): Guidance (iv): Blessings for making the mankind as devout believers. Two: The worst of all illness is the illness of the heart. Once a person’s heart has an illness, he tends to forget himself. Therefore, practise caution towards your heart to prevent it from becoming ill; should a person desire to become a human being and to have humanity values.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa nnaasu qad jaa'atkum mmaw'izatun mmin rrabbikum wasyifaa'un llimaa fii ssuduuri wahudan warahmatun llilmu'miniina

title: Strive to Meet God, You Will Surely Meet Him
text: O mankind! Surely you must strive towards your God, a hard striving, then you shall meet Him.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰا فَمُلَـٰقِیهِ
kataKunci: Spirit. Desire. To meet God. One. Concept of. Servitude. Godliness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear on mind: One: The task of searching God and to strive towards this is a responsibility that must be cultivated and flourished in those who believe in God. Two: Only the inner eye is able to see God. In other words, those who own an inner eye would be those who have successfully purified their hearts. Hence, chances for meeting and taking a closer look at His face is wide open.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa l'insaanu 'innaka kaadihun 'ilaa rabbika kadhan famulaaqiihi

title: Seek Worldly Gain, Get Both
text: Anyone who desires the reward of this world should know that Allah possesses rewards of both, this world and the hereafter. Allah hears all and sees all.
arabic: مَّن كَانَ یُرِیدُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنۡیَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ ثَوَابُ ٱلدُّنۡیَا وَٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِیعَۢا بَصِیرࣰا
kataKunci: Seek. Rewards. In this world. Obtain. Rewards. In this world. And. In the hereafter.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Tasks carried out in this world bring two (2) benefits, which are benefits for this world and the hereafter. Two: Every good task performed in this world is a form of worship. Therefore, partake in such activities in this world due to the two (2) benefits that await according to God’s pleasures.
translit: mman kaana yuriidu tsawaaba ddunyaa fa'inda llahi tsawaabu ddunyaa wal'aakhirati wakaana llahu samii'aa basiiran

title: Man Becomes an Animal When the Senses Are Not Used
text: Certainly. We have destined many jinns and human beings for hell; those are the ones who have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, they have ears with which they do not hear. They are like animals – or even worse than them, because they are those who are heedless.
arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ذَرَأۡنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِیرࣰا مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ لَهُمۡ قُلُوبࣱ لَّا یَفۡقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡیُنࣱ لَّا یُبۡصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمۡ ءَاذَانࣱ لَّا یَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۤۚ أُو۟لَـٰۤىِٕكَ كَٱلۡأَنۡعَـٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّۚ أُو۟لَـٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ ٱلۡغَـٰفِلُونَ
kataKunci: Mankind. Animals. When. Heart. Eyes. Ears. Not. Put in use
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are five (5) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man and humanity get destroyed with the emergence of a man destroying trait. Two: Man gets destroyed when the heart does not observe (aqliah). Three: Man gets destroyed when the eyes no longer see. Four: Man gets destroyed when the ears no longer listen. Five: Man transforms into an animal or even worse than one should one of those traits appear within himself.
translit: walaqad dzara'naa lijahannama katsiiran mmina ljinni wal'insi lahum quluubun llaa yafqahuuna bihaa walahum 'a'yunun llaa yubsiruuna bihaa walahum 'aadzaanun llaa yasma'uuna bihaa 'ulaa'ika kal'an'aami bal hum 'adhallu 'ulaa'ika humu lghaafiluuna

title: Following the Majority Leads Astray
text: If you obey most of the people on earth will lead you away from the way of Allah, for they follow nothing but guesswork and preach nothing but falsehood.
arabic: وَإِن تُطِعۡ أَكۡثَرَ مَن فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ یُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِیلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِن یَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا یَخۡرُصُونَ
kataKunci: Follow. The. Majority. Drift away. In. Deviance.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The concept of the majority’s views supporting the minority views is indeed democracy. Two: Fewer views do not necessarily mean to be wrong or deviant, despite them receiving tonnes of rejection from the majority and those in power. Three: The truth shall remain as the truth, whether it is accepted or rejected by the majority.
translit: wa'in tuti' 'aktsara man fii l'ardhi yudhilluuka 'an sabiili llahi 'in yattabi'uuna 'illaa zzanna wa'in hum 'illaa yakhrusuuna

title: Believe in Allah, Serve Your Parents, Do Good to Society
text: Serve Allah and do not commit shirk with Him, and be good to your parents, kinfolks, orphans, the helpless, near and far neighbours who keep company with you, the travellers in need, and the slaves you own. Allah does not love those who are arrogant and boastful.
arabic: ۞ وَٱعۡبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُشۡرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَیۡـࣰٔاۖ وَبِٱلۡوَ ٰلِدَیۡنِ إِحۡسَـٰنࣰا وَبِذِی ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡیَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَـٰكِینِ وَٱلۡجَارِ ذِی ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡجَارِ ٱلۡجُنُبِ وَٱلصَّاحِبِ بِٱلۡجَنۢبِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِیلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَیۡمَـٰنُكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخۡتَالࣰا فَخُورًا
kataKunci: Believing in. Allah. Serving. Both. Parents. Do good. Onto. The society.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A person must believe in Allah and never to commit shirk against Him. Two: Do good onto the nine (9) groups of mankind, i.e. parents, relatives, orphans, the poor, near and far neighbours, colleagues, travellers and your slaves. One must never be arrogant or boastful.
translit: wa'buduu llaha walaa tusyrikuu bihii syay'an wabilwaalidayni 'ihsaanan wabidzii lqurbaa walyataamaa walmasaakiini waljaari dzii lqurbaa waljaari ljunubi wassaahibi biljanbi wabni ssabiili wamaa malakat 'aymaanukum 'inna llaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaalan fakhuuran

title: Power in the Name
text: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful
arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِیمِ
kataKunci: Power. On – The Name. Task. On - The name. Service. On – The name
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Whatever tasks that are undertaken in life must be carried out in the name of God. Two: Whenever something is carried out in the name of God, it reflects: Qul innasalaati wanusuki…ilakh.
translit: bismi llahi rrahmaani rrahiimi

title: Riba, Destroyer of Agreements
text: O believers! Do not live on usury which is compounded over and over again. Have fear of Allah so that you may prosper.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأۡكُلُوا۟ ٱلرِّبَوٰۤا۟ أَضۡعَـٰفࣰا مُّضَـٰعَفَةࣰۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
kataKunci: Usury. Disrupts. Economy. Destroys. Agreement
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: An agreement remains as an agreement. Every detail is fixed and cannot be altered. As long as they are followed and are not altered, it remains genuine. Two: Should any detail be breached, especially pertaining to financial matters, it transforms into usury. Three: On the other hand, if details of an agreement are not breached, it can never be classified as usury although its applicable interest is huge portraying the Dracula drawing blood from its victims. Four: Learn more about matters concerning agreements and economic loans to prevent from being deceived and manipulated by others.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu laa ta'kuluu rribawaa 'adh'aafan mmudhaa'afatan wattaquu llaha la'allakum tuflihuuna

title: Iblis, Misleader of Mankind
text: The Devil said: I swear by Your Honour, I will mislead them all (Adam and his descendants) except your chosen sincere devotees among them.
arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِیَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِینَ إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِینَ
kataKunci: Devil. Destroys. Humanity. Disobeys. Towards. God. A. Warning.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Devil incites the mankind due to his agreement with God. Two: The Devil does not incite the mankind, except on the name: Bismillah – God to prove that every belief and Godliness must be tested. It is fortunate to have the Devil to prevent the mankind from lying.
translit: qaala fabi'izzatika la'ughwiyannahum 'ajma'iina 'illaa 'ibaadaka minhumu lmukhlasiina

title: Amthal, the Source of Furqan
text: Allah does not mind using the similitude of a gnat or an even more insignificant creature. Those who believe, know that it is the truth from their God; but the unbelievers say: What does Allah mean by such a similitude? By such similitude, Allah confounds many and enlightens many. He confounds none except te transgressors.
arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا یَسۡتَحۡیِۦۤ أَن یَضۡرِبَ مَثَلࣰا مَّا بَعُوضَةࣰ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَیَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِینَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَیَقُولُونَ مَاذَاۤ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلࣰاۘ یُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِیرࣰا وَیَهۡدِی بِهِۦ كَثِیرࣰاۚ وَمَا یُضِلُّ بِهِۦۤ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَـٰسِقِینَ
kataKunci: Amthal. Natural. Resource. Source of. Furqan. Generates. Development.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The tiny must never be taken for granted as even the tiny can prove to be powerful. The gnat as huge powers as they bring germs (malaria) and viruses (Dengue). The same goes with the Covid-19 virus that has struck the entire world causing a state of emergency (March 2020) as a result from undesirable eating habits. Two: There’s no need to dispose the big ones as even the tinier ones contain secrets that reflect the good and the bad in the form of furqan that needs to be explored and discovered. Nevertheless, even catastrophes that appear too signify development.
translit: 'inna llaha laa yastahyii 'an yadhriba matsalan mmaa ba'uudhatan famaa fawqahaa fa'ammaa lladziina 'aamanuu faya'lamuuna 'annahu lhaqqu min rrabbihim wa'ammaa lladziina kafaruu fayaquuluuna maadzaa 'araada llahu bihaadzaa matsalan yudhillu bihii katsiiran wayahdii bihii katsiiran wamaa yudhillu bihii 'illaa lfaasiqiina

title: Doing Evil While Feeling Good / Hypocrites
text: When it is said to them: Do not make mischief on earth. The say: We make peace. Beware! They are the ones who make mischief but they do not realize it.
arabic: وَإِذَا قِیلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُوا۟ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قَالُوۤا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُونَ أَلَاۤ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا یَشۡعُرُونَ
kataKunci: Commit. Evil. Feel. Good. A condemned. Trait. Admonished. By God.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Evil doings exist when the eyes deliberately turn blind, making the evil seen in the form of good. Two: In life, a person must be made aware of the evil and the good to prevent life from appearing as the night and the day. Three: A person’s mouth and heart must be courageous. So whenever the eyes spot anything evil, one must admit seeing evil to withhold the truth.
translit: wa'idzaa qiila lahum laa tufsiduu fii l'ardhi qaaluu 'innamaa nahnu muslihuuna 'alaa 'innahum humu lmufsiduuna walaakin llaa yasy'uruuna

title: Man, the Best of Creation
text: We have indeed created man in the best stature; then We abase him to the lowest of the low except those who believe and do good deeds – for they shall have a never ending reward.
arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ فِیۤ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِیمࣲ ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَـٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَـٰفِلِینَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَیۡرُ مَمۡنُونࣲ
kataKunci: Man. With a vision. The best. Creation. Without. Vision. Turns into. An animal.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Man will turn into an animal should humanity fail to exist within himself. Two: Man will turn into an animal when the heart, eyes and ears are not put into proper use. Three: Man will be portrayed as actual people when they practice the vision’s concept of: Aamanuu wa’amilusshaalihaat in their lives.
translit: laqad khalaqnaa l'insaana fii 'ahsani taqwiimin tsumma radadnaahu 'asfala saafiliina 'illaa lladziina 'aamanuu wa'amiluu ssaalihaati falahum 'ajrun ghayru mamnuunin

title: News Needs Verification
text: O believers, if an evildoer comes to you with some news, verify it, lest you should harm others unwittingly and then regret what you have done.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوۤا۟ إِن جَاۤءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإࣲ فَتَبَیَّنُوۤا۟ أَن تُصِیبُوا۟ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةࣲ فَتُصۡبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَـٰدِمِینَ
kataKunci: News. Needs. Verification. Persecute. People. A form of. Unjustness.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Whenever a news comes from amongst the transgressors, verify it first before it tarnishes or destroys image of others. Two: There have been numerous cases where people regret seeing repercussions that appear due to the spread of slander made by the transgressors through news brought by them.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu 'in jaa'akum faasiqu binaba'in fatabayyanuu 'an tusiibuu qawmaa bijahaalatin fatusbihuu 'alaa maa fa'altum naadimiina

title: Believers Are Brothers
text: The believers are brothers to one another, therefore make reconciliation between your brothers and fear Allah, so that you may be shown mercy
arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةࣱ فَأَصۡلِحُوا۟ بَیۡنَ أَخَوَیۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
kataKunci: The. Believers. Brothers. Reconcile. Disputes. Between. Them.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The believers are brothers with one another. Therefore, reconcile with one another. Two: Whenever a dispute or hostility occurs between the two, seek reconciliation and truce for the sake of harmony.
translit: 'innamaa lmu'minuuna 'ikhwatun fa'aslihuu bayna 'akhawaykum wattaquu llaha la'allakum turhamuuna

title: Keep the Pledge / The Knowledge of Wasilah
text: Surely those who swore allegiance to you, indeed swore allegiance to Allah Himself. The Hand of Allah was above their hands. Now, the one who will break his pledge, will break it at his own peril, and the one who will keep his pledge that he has made with Allah, shall soon be given a great reward by Him.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِینَ یُبَایِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا یُبَایِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ یَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَیۡدِیهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا یَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَـٰهَدَ عَلَیۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَیُؤۡتِیهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِیمࣰا
kataKunci: Knowledge. Wasilah. Allegiance. Without. Allegiance. Knowledge. Becomes. Meaningless
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Every knowledge acquired must be taught by a teacher, whether it is a physical teacher (Qalam knowledgeability) or the unseen teacher (Laduni knowledgeability) Two: Acquiring the Godly knowledge requires wasilah and every wasilah-based knowledge requires the Allegiance teachings (teaching pledge). Otherwise, the knowledge will not be considered legitimate or successful. Three: Those who are in allegiance with their musyid will be in allegiance with Rasulullah s.a.w and those who continue their allegiance with Rasulullah s.a.w. shall have their allegiance continued with Allahu azzawajalla. Four: Allegiance (pledge) must be preserved well to ensure knowledge is formed as the continuity of a chain which can never be broken similar to the telephone line.
translit: 'inna lladziina yubaayi'uunaka 'innamaa yubaayi'uuna llaha yadu llahi fawqa 'aydiihim faman nnakatsa fa'innamaa yankutsu 'alaa nafsihii waman 'awfaa bimaa 'aahada 'alayhu llaha fasayu'tiihi 'ajran 'aziiman

title: Solat Prevents Wickedness
text: Recite the Al Quran which has been revealed to you and establish solat. Surely solat keeps one away from shameful and evil deeds; and surely the remembrance of Allah is the greatest indeed, Allah knows what you do.
arabic: ٱتۡلُ مَاۤ أُوحِیَ إِلَیۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَاۤءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ یَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ
kataKunci: Solat. Prevents. Wickedness. Why. It is. Rampant. In the form of. Deception.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The act of reciting the Al Quran is an absolute obligation that must be put into practice by the believers. Reciting in terms of studying its meaning and to ponder upon the Al Quran. Two: Solat refers to the act of witnessing God. So, when God is close by, people would feel embarrassed to partake in evil activities before Him. Three: Feeling embarrassed before God is only felt by those who understand, always see and witness Him as they believe in God. Four: Solat is not only confined to the prayer mats to witness Him. Instead, this act can be performed anywhere.
translit: atlu maa 'uuhiya 'ilayka mina lkitaabi wa'aqimi ssalawaata 'inna ssalawaata tanhaa 'ani lfahsyaa'i walmunkari waladzikru llahi 'akbaru wallahu ya'lamu maa tasna'uuna

title: Mutmainnah: The Soul at the Accepted Level
text: O’ satisfied soul (Mutmaiinnah), return to your God, well pleased with Him and well-pleasing to Him. Join My servants, and enter My Paradise.
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَىِٕنَّةُ ٱرۡجِعِیۤ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِیَةࣰ مَّرۡضِیَّةࣰ فَٱدۡخُلِی فِی عِبَـٰدِی وَٱدۡخُلِی جَنَّتِی
kataKunci: Mutmainnah. Level. Desire. Accepted. Paradise. Grasped. Self.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life must seek for tranquility as it is mother of all easiness. Thus, easiness is formed by favours and blessings. Two: Desires function as a yardstick of humanity and so does tranquility. Three: Paradise which reflects tranquility only accepts those who experience tranquility along with Allah’s calmness and splendors of Paradise. Four: Always remind yourselves to seek and own Mutmainnah through the Godly wasilah.
translit: yaa'ayyatuhaa nnafsu lmutma'innatu rji'ii 'ilaa rabbiki raadhiyatan mmardhiyyatan fadkhulii fii 'ibaadii wadkhulii jannatii

title: The Truth of Religion in 3 Aspects
text: and Shaabi iins – whoever believes in Allah and the Judgement Day and performs good deeds – will be rewarded by their God; they will have nothing to fear or to regret.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِینَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔینَ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡیَوۡمِ ٱلۡـَٔاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحࣰا فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَیۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ یَحۡزَنُونَ
kataKunci: Truth. Acceptance. Religion. In. Three. Aspects
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Preaching does not mean to force people to embrace the religion but to urge the people to practice the three (3) principles: (i): Urge the people to believe in Allah. (ii): Urge the people to believe in the Judgement Day. (iii): Urge the people to become innovators and to partake in innovative activities. Two: The Muslims, Jews, Christians and Shaabi iins are not required to convert their respective religions as long as they implement the three (3) said principles as God’s acceptance will always be with them.
translit: 'inna lladziina 'aamanuu walladziina haaduu wannasaaraa wassaabi'iina man 'aamana billahi walyawmi l'aakhiri wa'amila saalihan falahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim walaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanuuna

title: The Heart's Eye, Kashaf
text: You were heedless of this, but now We have removed your veil, so your eyesight is sharp today.
arabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِی غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَاۤءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡیَوۡمَ حَدِیدࣱ
kataKunci: Bashir. Eye. Produces. Heart’s. Sight. Turned kasyaf. Sharpness. Eyesight.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are three (3) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Carelessness can occur due to three (3) reasons: (i): Careless for not knowing. (ii): Carelessness for turning a blind eye in seeing. (iii): Carelessness due to difficulty in accepting changes. Two: Carelessness in terms of seeing will occur especially when the unseen needs to be seen in the form of reality. It is at such instance the bashir eye along with a person’s sight as kasyaf must be put in place. Three: The sharpest of all sights is the bashir eye along with its kasyaf sight.
translit: llaqad kunta fii ghaflatin mmin haadzaa fakasyafnaa 'anka ghitaa'aka fabasaruka lyawma hadiidun

title: The Heart Rusts Easily
text: Of course not! In fact their misdeeds have caused a covering on their hearts.
arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ یَكۡسِبُونَ
kataKunci: Heart. Simple. Rusted. When. Performing. Evil doings
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The rusted heart is a heart that cannot transmit Nur Qalbi to the nerves of a person and fails to receive rays of ilahi’s inspirations onto the mind’s filament that appear behind a person’s head. Two: Evil doings form rust in the heart, where Nur Qalbi that appears in the right and left ventricles of the heart becomes blocked. This is due to man breaching God’s requirement of norms which causes the heart to become blind.
translit: kallaa bal raana 'alaa quluubihim mmaa kaanuu yaksibuuna

title: Furqan Is of No Use to Those Who Reject
text: Say: Look at whatever exists in the heavens and the earth. Signs and warnings do not benefit those people who do not believe.
arabic: قُلِ ٱنظُرُوا۟ مَاذَا فِی ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَا تُغۡنِی ٱلۡـَٔایَـٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوۡمࣲ لَّا یُؤۡمِنُونَ
kataKunci: Furqan. Hidden. Not. Beneficial. If. Not. Enriched.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Apes will remain as apes as they refuse to turn into human beings, and they cannot become human beings as they are blinded in seeing a boat that exists in a tree’s bark. Two: Trees in the form of trees cannot become developed but instead as a form of development when a tree is discovered and transformed into a boat. This is among the benefits of God’s that must be created by man to prevent the ape-like traits to appear within them.
translit: quli nzuruu maadzaa fii ssamaawaati wal'ardhi wamaa tughnii l'aayaatu wannudzuru 'an qawmin llaa yu'minuuna

title: Mind Your Provisions for the Future
text: O believers! Fear Allah and let every soul see what it is sending for tomorrow. Fear Allah, surely Allah is aware of all your actions
arabic: یَـٰۤأَیُّهَا ٱلَّذِینَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلۡتَنظُرۡ نَفۡسࣱ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ لِغَدࣲۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِیرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
kataKunci: Preparing. For. The. Future. Colours of. Life. Godliness
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Life requires preparations. Life without such preparations will be similar to the sky without clouds – empty and dry. Two: Preparations made for life in this world reflects as life’s pattern in this world. Three: Preparations made for life in this world reflects as life’s pattern in the hereafter. Four: This world serves as a place for investing where the world’s investment for life must be made in this world itself and so is investment for the hereafter which must be made while in this world.
translit: yaa'ayyuhaa lladziina 'aamanuu ttaquu llaha waltanzur nafsun mmaa qaddamat lighadin wattaquu llaha 'inna llaha khabiiru bimaa ta'maluuna

title: Power of Al-Quran's Knowledge, Mountains Crumble
text: If We had sent down this Al Quran on a mountain, you would have seen it humble itself and split asunder from the fear of Allah. We are citing this example for mankind, so that they may take heed.
arabic: لَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلࣲ لَّرَأَیۡتَهُۥ خَـٰشِعࣰا مُّتَصَدِّعࣰا مِّنۡ خَشۡیَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَـٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ یَتَفَكَّرُونَ
kataKunci: Strength. Al Quran. Knowledge. Extremely. Seen. Eyes. Thinking
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: The Al Quran possess its very own powers created by God of the worlds.. Two: The Al Quran’s strength is stated by Zaboor. It is a Holy Scripture during the civilization of Daud a.s and Sulaiman a.s. This means that the Al Quran has the ability to create civilization for the mankind similar to the civilization of Daud a.s. In fact, it is able to generate a higher civilization and relevance with time. Three: The Al Quran’s strength is similar to the nuclear if it is interpreted and deliberated accordingly. Four: The Al Quran is similar to the dense virgin forest which is yet to be explored. Apes with faces of man have failed to become proper human beings as they claim that the forest is their sole property – A dilemma.
translit: law 'anzalnaa haadzaa lqur'aana 'alaa jabalin llara'aytahuu khaasyi'an mmutasaddi'an mmin khasyyati llahi watilka l'amtsaalu nadhribuhaa linnaasi la'allahum yatafakkaruuna

title: Ranks Depend on Deeds
text: All will be assigned in ranks, according to their deeds, so that He may reward them fully for what they have done and they shall not be wronged.
arabic: وَلِكُلࣲّ دَرَجَـٰتࣱ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ۖ وَلِیُوَفِّیَهُمۡ أَعۡمَـٰلَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا یُظۡلَمُونَ
kataKunci: Ranks. Depend. On. Deeds. Tasks. Undertaken
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Every effort leads to ranks. Two: Type and size of efforts put in determines the height of ranks. Three: Each and every effort needs to be collaborated with God. Four: Man must complete their portion of tasks (build confines - example). Only then will God complete His part – Man builds confines and God grows leaves and tapioca bulbs – as an example).
translit: walikullin darajaatun mmimmaa 'amiluu waliyuwaffiyahum 'a'maalahum wahum laa yuzlamuuna

title: The Seven Repeated Ayat
text: We have given you the Seven Verses (Al Fatihah) that are worthy of recitation over and over again and the glorious Al Quran
arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَیۡنَـٰكَ سَبۡعࣰا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِی وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِیمَ
kataKunci: Al Fatihah. Seven. Principles. Life. Godliness. Source of. Blessings. Prosperity.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are four (4) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: A person must know that the Al Fatihah is mother of the Al Quran. Two: The Al Quran is mother of all guidances and teachings. Three: Gist of the Al Fatihah refers to Godliness and life. Four: A person must understand the meaning of help from God which refers to man and humanity.
translit: walaqad 'aataynaaka sab'an mmina lmatsaanii walqur'aana l'aziima

title: Forget Quran, Satan Takes Control
text: He who turns away from the remembrance of the Compassion - Ar Rahman (Al Quran), We assign a satan for him who becomes his intimate companion.
arabic: وَمَن یَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ نُقَیِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَیۡطَـٰنࣰا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِینࣱ
kataKunci: Al Quran. Reminder. Ar Rahman. Ignores. Al Quran. Satans. Control. One’s self.
catitan: Whenever reciting this ayat, there are two (2) aspects a person must bear in mind: One: Understand that the Al Quran is a reminder of peringatan Ar Rahman as a spark of love and care. Two: Understand that whoever ignores the Al Quran's reminder, the person gets closer to the satans and thus befriends them.
translit: waman ya'syu 'an dzikri rrahmaani nuqayyidh lahuu syaytaanan fahuwa lahuu qariinun
